paragraphs.text: This is a timeline of the Magic: The Gathering storyline . It is an unofficial document, but all information on it is taken from official canon sources ( see: list of storyline sources ). All stories that could be dated or couldn't be dated but could be placed at some point in the timeline because of their connection to other stories have been incorporated to the fullest possible extent. Note that this timeline is not completely accurate, and some events have an estimated date or a date range in which they could have occurred.

Several calendar systems are known, and cultures from different locations or on different planes have varied year zeroes . This unofficial timeline standardizes on Argivian Reckoning , AR, the dominant calendar used on Dominaria .

Some sources indicate that planes have years of varying lengths. However, the official, internal, unpublished timeline used by Wizards of the Coast assumes that years are "roughly analogous" between planes, because accepting those sources at face value would be a "logistical nightmare".
In Cridhe , the years are given as they relate to the Parting . The only date known is that of the Mending of the Clan Tree , in Year 520.

Most of Dominaria uses Argivian Reckoning , with year 0 starting with the birth of Urza and ending with the birth of Mishra . Other known reckonings are Penregon Founded, beginning with the founding of the city Penregon in -912 AR, and the Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad, starting with the gathering in 3000 AR of said sages. A Dominarian year is 420 days long and divided into twelve 35-day months.

Most dates from the Armada comics were given in the Minorad reckoning, but many can't possibly be true or have been proven untrue in later continuity. Minorad reckoning is only incorporated in the timeline and translated to AR if it remains true in the current continuity.

New Sumifans established another dating system in Almaaz . Its Common Era (CE) starts around 3035 AR (Date of 3000 BCE (Before Common Era) corresponds to times of Brothers, soon after Almaaz joined to Mishra 's forces).

Dates on Innistrad are measured using the moon's stages and the years of Avacyn, commonly shortened to "Ava." As the year Ava. 1 is centuries later than Avacyn's creation, it may relate to the creation of her church or another important date in Innistrad's history. There are three seasons on Innistrad: Harvest Moon (autumn), Hunter's Moon (winter), and New Moon (spring). It is unclear exactly how long a season or a year on Innistrad lasts, although Hunter's Moon is said to be the longest and New Moon the shortest. The latest dates known for each season are the 118th of Harvest Moon in the years of Avacyn 699 and 711, the 121st of Hunter's Moon, Ava. 718, and the 116th of the New Moon, Ava. 714, meaning an Innistradi year could last at least 355 days.
Years in the Legion of Dusk are marked by their distance from the Legion's arrival on the continent of Ixalan, with years beforehand labeled "Before Dawn" (BD) and years after labeled "Dawn Era."

Ravnica works with AC and ZC, which stand for "Al Concordant" and "Zal Concordant", meaning "Before the Agreement" and "After the Agreement" in Old Ravi, respectively. The agreement, in this case, is the signing of the Guildpact . The D&D Guildmasters' Guide to Ravnica establishes the Ravnican date of the Return to Ravnica block as 10,075 ZC, which took place in 4558 AR . By this reckoning, the year 0 ZC began during the year -5517 AR (assuming there is both a year 0 AR and a year 0 ZC). A Ravnican year is 365 days, each of its twelve months matching up in length with their Gregorian calendar counterpart.

The Meletian calendar is irregular, with most years being 354 days. About every three years, a thirteenth month of 30 days is added for 384 days to account for the misaligned solar year. Months on Theros alternate between 30 and 29 days.
Billions of years ago
The Sothera system forms. Billions of years later, but still in the distant past, the Kav are born on Kavaron .
The Eldrazi battle the Fomori across the Blind Eternities . The Fomori-Eldrazi war eventually spills onto the Edge . Alongside the Drix , the Fomori triumph, but disappear afterward.
The Vaar upload themselves into cyberspace to escape the Eldrazi.
The demi-planes Ezroi and Karudis merge, forming Arcavios and beginning the Dawning Age.
The consciousness of every future Oracle of Arcavios arrives at this point from the moment of their death, where they become the Archaics . Jace Beleren is also present, reading the mind of Jadzi .
The Equilorians begin their search for enlightenment.
Birth of the Elder Dragons - the Ur-Dragon spawns the first dragons on Dominaria . They collectively become known as the Elder Dragons . Merrevia Sal is killed by human dragon hunters.
The Dragon-killers' War - Ugin 's spark ignites, becoming the first known planeswalker.
Between c. -19,000 and -17,000

The Elder Dragon War - the victors of the war are Nicol Bolas (who ascended), Arcades Sabboth , Palladia-Mors and Chromium , and his cousins Vaevictis Asmadi and Piru . Those who lose the war are beaten to the ground, stripped of their title, never to fly again, becoming Wurms .
Ugin , not present for the war, shapes Tarkir .
Fall of the Primevals - on Dominaria, the Numena defeat the Primeval Dragons and take their powers.
Rokin of Mitrokin is sacrificed to the dragon lords and enslaved in the Obsidian Well , but he leads a revolt to overthrow them when their magic fails after the Primevals' fall.
Fall of the Numena - On Dominaria, the Numena fall after ruling for 1,000 years.
On the Meditation Plane , Nicol Bolas kills Ugin for the first time.

Shattering of Madara - Nicol Bolas battles the Demonic Leviathan . The fight reduces Madara to a third of its former size and creates the first rift of the world. What remains of the Leviathan comes to be known as the Talon Gates .
Niv-Mizzet , the last great dragon on Ravnica , hatches.
Azor arrives on Ravnica.

paragraphs.text: Signing of the Guildpact - the Guildpact is created on the plane of Ravnica after a long war led by the opposing Cisarzim and Razia. Ravnican guilds divide duties across nine guilds for the betterment of the plane as a whole. Ravnica begins its long evolution into a predominantly urban plane.

paragraphs.text: Commander-General Ferrous Rokiric erects the ten stone Titans of Ravnica in each district of the city to quell rebellion and maintain peace.

paragraphs.text: The Thran Civil War happens in Terisiare , ending when the eugenicists including Yawgmoth are exiled.

paragraphs.text: Fatima breaks up with al-Abin , becomes a planeswalker, builds the City of Brass , and creates the Brass Men .

paragraphs.text: The Thran-Phyrexian War - Yawgmoth comes to power among the Thran . With the help of Dyfed , he claims control of a decaying plane that he reshapes into Phyrexia , and wages war against the greater Thran Alliance
paragraphs.section: Time of the Thran (Up to c. -5000 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ] [ 30 ]

paragraphs.text: Dyfed transports many of Yawgmoth's political enemies to Mercadia , leaving them stranded.

paragraphs.text: The Battle of the Null Sphere takes place, giving Yawgmoth access to the powers of the Null Sphere .

paragraphs.text: The Battle of Megheddon Defile takes place, eliminating one of the Thran Alliance armies and the entire defile itself.
paragraphs.section: Time of the Thran (Up to c. -5000 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ] [ 30 ]

paragraphs.text: The Battle of Halcyon - the Null Moon is launched into orbit, the Thran Empire is destroyed, and Yawgmoth is trapped on Phyrexia by Glacian and Rebbec 's closure of the planar portal in the Caves of the Damned .

paragraphs.text: Sorin Markov is born on the plane of Innistrad .

paragraphs.text: Humanoids emerge on Arcavios , ending the Dawning Age. Conflicts between these groups begin the Blood Age.

paragraphs.text: Shilgengar's Ritual - Edgar Markov creates the curse of vampirism on Innistrad with the assistance of the demon Shilgengar when Sorin Markov is sixteen. Turning into a vampire causes Sorin's spark to ignite. Olivia Voldaren , Runo Stromkirk , Strefan Maurer and Irska Dusken also partake of the ritual.

paragraphs.text: Sivitri's War - Sivitri Scarzam conquers south-eastern Corondor with the help of her dragons, until they are destroyed with a special potion made from Sol'Kanar 's poppies. Sivitri flees Dominaria on her last remaining dragon.

paragraphs.text: The kingdom of Zhalfir takes shape on Jamuraa .
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Tev Loneglade is born.

paragraphs.text: Forging the Blackblade - Dakkon forges the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada , who in exchange triggers his spark. Geyadrone Dihada conquers the south of Corondor and turns the nature spirit of Khone into Sol'Kanar the Swamp King .
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Enslavement of Trine - Xarl turns the Serra Angel Trine into a Fallen Angel using the Horned Halo and conquers the north of Corondor, ruling for three centuries.
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Between -1500 and -200
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Absolution of Trine - Eskil , the adopted son of the magician Xarl, summons the angel Rahel to subdue Trine. Eskil is blinded in the final conflict but ascends as a planeswalker.
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Blackblade–Dihada War - Dihada tricks a young boy from the destroyed village Carth into summoning Dakkon Blackblade and binding them to each other. Dakkon slays Dihada's minion, the Elder Piru , but Dihada absorbs her power. Dihada marks Dakkon as one of her champions, but gets back his shadow. The boy from Carth and Dakkon travel to Terisiare. The boy starts the lineage of the Carthalions .
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Date of Tribute - Left by his mistress, Sol'Kanar seeks to increase his power through annual tributes over several years.
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Dragon War - The two women Chondaeh and Gydolien Mor try to summon the last of the Scarzam Dragons for Sol'Kanar . They succeed, but Sivitri Scarzam also appears and turns against the Swamp King. In the aftermath, the city of Khone is destroyed.
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Sorin , Ugin , and Nahiri meet on an unknown plane destroyed by the Eldrazi . They hatch a plan to imprison the Eldrazi.
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Imprisonment of the Eldrazi - The Eldrazi are imprisoned on Zendikar by Sorin, Ugin , and Nahiri .
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: The Battle at Mors Ridge takes place. Chromium Rhuell battles and defeats Vaevictis Asmadi and Palladia-Mors .
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: The Panther Warriors of Lord Windgrace 's tribe rule Urborg until the Brothers' War.
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: The Whispering War ends in Ixalan's Core and the Age of the Sun begins.
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Start of Argivian Reckoning - Urza and Mishra are born on the first and last day of the Dominarian year, respectively. This marks the beginning of a new calendar, retroactively counting from this year as year 0, effectively replacing the Penregon Founding dating system completely.
paragraphs.section: Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]

paragraphs.text: Discovery of Koilos - Urza , Mishra , and Tocasia discover Koilos , in which the portal to Phyrexia is enclosed. The brothers split the powerstone by accident.
paragraphs.section: The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]

paragraphs.text: Brotherhood's End - The conflict between the brothers rises, with Tocasia caught in between. She dies when hit by energy beams from the stones. Mishra flees into the desert and is enslaved by Fallaji nomads. Urza becomes an apprentice clockmaker in Kroog .
paragraphs.section: The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]

paragraphs.text: Peace Summit at Korlinda - Urza and Mishra meet for the first time since their argument at a failed peace summit. The Warlord of Kroog is killed by the Qadir of the Fallaji .
paragraphs.section: The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]

paragraphs.text: The Brotherhood of Gix summons a Phyrexian demon through the portal at Koilos. It announces that its name is Gix and orders the brotherhood to infiltrate both sides of the war.
paragraphs.section: The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]

paragraphs.text: The Beast of the Hours is imprisoned beneath Sarraza by Samor the Collector.
paragraphs.section: The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]

paragraphs.text: Fall of Sumifa - the city's crown prince Porros kills Samor and buries Sumifa beneath the desert sands.
paragraphs.section: The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]

paragraphs.text: Battle at Argoth - the final battle of the Brothers' War takes place on the island of Argoth . Gix makes all the artifact creatures in both armies go berserk. Mishra is revealed to have been altered by Phyrexian constructs.
paragraphs.section: The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]

paragraphs.text: Sylex Blast - Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex , obliterating Argoth, turning Urborg into a swamp, and sending all of Dominaria towards an Ice Age . Urza ignites his spark and becomes a planeswalker . The Shard of the Twelve Worlds begins to form. Gix and his minions retreat to Phyrexia.
paragraphs.section: The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]

paragraphs.text: Captain Crucias is blinded by the blast, and all but one of his passengers, Elgia , are killed. He later ascends and becomes the planeswalker Bo Levar .
paragraphs.section: The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]

paragraphs.text: Xantcha is created from Mishra 's flesh, her pod of newts being prepared to invade Dominaria as sleeper agents .
Annise breaks up with her boyfriend. He steals her magical pendant and goes to duel her boss, Dumoss , but she shows up and distracts him, making him lose the duel.
Loran dies of an illness. Feldon tries to resurrect her with different types of magic.
Founding the Conclave of Mages
Jarsyl joins the Conclave of Mages .

Xantcha 's pod is launched onto Dominaria . Before she can be assigned, however, the strangely identical-looking and too-small newts are slaughtered by the plane's inhabitants. As a replacement, a new batch of more individual-looking newts starts being created.
The Thousandfold Refraction of Rabiah
Marooned on an island of sea dragons, Agrippa escapes with gold and a story to clear his family’s name.
Unification of Taysir - Taysir of Rabiah becomes a planeswalker and leaves Rabiah .
Gwenna sacrifices her life to save Temken 's elves from a malevolent swamp spirit. The Survivors head west to found Yavimaya .
The Fall of the Sarpadian Empires occurs, wiping out civilization on Sarpadia . The dwarven empire of the Crimson Peaks is the first to fall. Galina is transported 3137 years into the future.
Urza meets the defective Phyrexian newt Xantcha . He thinks she's a human turned Phyrexian and takes her along with him in his crusade against Yawgmoth.
Nevinyrral activates his disk on Urborg, ending the war between Urborg and Bogardan but destroying Urborg's capital in the process.
The Iwset-Jehesic War takes place on the west coast of Terisiare .
Mita becomes the first female Rag Man , granting her the power to travel the world through dreams.
Jarsyl discovers a portal to Phyrexia while living in his tower in Giva Province . He writes about his experiences from the metal plane, before vanishing without a trace.
Taysir comes to Dominaria and falls in love with Kristina of the Woods . They are both trapped when the Shard closes, not much later.
Formation of the Shard of Twelve Worlds - the Shard forms, trapping all planeswalkers in a section of the multiverse including Dominaria and eleven other planes.
Lord Ith is imprisoned by Mairsil .
Tivadar of Thorn is born.
Torya Longshanks lifts the blood-curse of king Rogan of Angremur .
The magic of Barl's Cage starts to weaken.
Lord Ith manages to cast a spell through Barl's Cage , summoning the Rag Man to get aid.
Jodah receives his mirror from Voska .
The Battle of Pitdown - Jodah gains near-immortality after hiding from Goblins in a Fountain of Youth .
The Fall of the Conclave of Mages - Jodah frees Lord Ith, and Ith destroys the Conclave of Mages .
Jodah journeys with Sima to the City of Shadows where he eventually becomes the Archmage Eternal.
Tivadar's Crusade - Tivadar of Thorn and Rasputin Dreamweaver lead a successful crusade against the goblin hordes of Terisiare .
Almaaz is taken over by the Rigida .
Start of the Ice Age .

Urza finishes his eight-legged dragon engine , and Xantcha starts waiting for the Phyrexians to appear on the unnamed world where Urza met her. She waits for almost 200 years. Meanwhile, Urza discovers he has been locked out of Dominaria by the Formation of the Shard of Twelve Worlds .

Sima dies. The grief of this event is the latest in a long line of emotional strains for Jodah, who begins to descend into madness. He saves himself by using his mirror to save his memories, wipe his mind clean, and use the memories in the mirror to regain himself without the emotional attachment. Jodah will repeat this roughly once a century for 2500 years.
Chaeska erects the fortress of Tresserhorn on the site of the fallen Conclave of Mages .
On an unspecified plane within the Shard, Ravidel is apprenticed to Faralyn . Faralyn brings Ravidel to Dominaria, where Ravidel befriends the elder dragon Chromium Rhuell .

Urza's Assault on Phyrexia - Xantcha finally spots Phyrexians on her world and warns Urza . Urza launches an attack on Phyrexia , but is defeated. Yawgmoth corrupts Urza, causing him to slowly degenerate into madness.
Xantcha discovers Phyrexians infiltrating a fire god cult on Moag . Urza destroys the fire god's temple, and they flee the plane.
The Cult of Rimewind rises near the growing Ronom Glacier .
Xantcha and Urza hide from the Phyrexians on a harsh, icy world. They are attacked and wounded, and they flee to Serra's Realm , where they spend an unspecified amount of time being healed.
The order of the Ninnites forms in Almaaz .
On Dominaria, the city of Sumifa is rebuilt near its old site.
Urza and Xantcha head for the ancient world of Equilor . They spend far more than a millennium to reach it.
A planeswalker battle devastates the Foulmere , leaving Peter Langwynd to raise the Dobéhma child Mao .
The Age of the Sun ends in Ixalan's Core . Aclazotz escapes the veil and begins the Night War.
Some time during the Ice Age, a mercantile affiliation between several trading fleets establishes the Sheoltun Empire on Aerona .
The Night War ends. Aclazotz is imprisoned. The First Exodus period begins.
King Ojanen, the cat warrior, stands up to his creator, Terrent Amese , who, in response, creates Ur-Drago to exact his revenge. Ojanen is killed, and Scarwood is lost to the cat tribes.
Fall of Storgard - thanks to the meddling of Tevesh Szat, the kingdom of Storgard falls. Freyalise ascends. Jason Carthalion and Oriel Kjeldos travel south with their followers and found Kjeldor .
Marit Lage is imprisoned by unknown means under the Ronom Glacier .
Phyrexians follow the trail of Urza to Serra's Realm and invade it, prompting Serra to flee and Radiant to rise to power.
Balduvia , traditionally claiming the lands settled by Kjeldorans , declares war, starting a 400-year long period of strife between the two nations.
The Mycotyrant is born in the caverns of Ixalan . The Core is quarantined, and humans travel from the caverns to the plane's surface.

Centuries after the banishment of the cat warriors of Scarwood , the elves of Scarwood are also driven away. This time, it is a tribe of giant apes who are the culprit. The elves relocate to the hidden city outside Scarwood.
Keld is founded by Kradak .
Barrin learns the Blare of Doom.
Arcades Sabboth is forcibly summoned by Leshrac in a duel with Kristina of the Woods . Kristina is forced to kill Arcades.

Márton Stromgald 's squad is wiped out by a band of goblins , with the soldier Lim-Dûl as the only survivor. Lim-Dûl escapes through a blizzard and stumbles upon Mairsil 's ring in a cave outside Tresserhorn . He puts the ring on, and the two entities merge into a unified whole. Shortly afterward, Lim-Dûl-Mairsil takes over Tresserhorn and makes it his base of operations.
Jaya Ballard is born in Terisiare, Dominaria.
Lord Rothchild holds the regency of Kjeldor , ruling from the southern city of Jornstad for some time until Darien 's mother takes the throne.

Zur the Enchanter leads a revolt against the established magical leaders of Kjeldor and retreats to the Kjeldoran Hinterlands , eventually disappearing. His followers remain an irritant to their nation until the formation of New Argive .
Two poachers kill a lhurgoyf and steal its eggs, leading its mate to wreak havoc until it is stopped by Jaya Ballard .
Darien 's mother, the queen of Kjeldor , dies, leaving the throne to her son.
Jodah is abducted from the School of the Unseen by Lim-Dûl and imprisoned in Tresserhorn until he is freed by Jaya Ballard , but without his mirror, he starts to go mad from his built-up memories.
Jaya steals back Jodah's mirror from Gustha Ebbasdotter in the Royal Academy of Magic in Krov and uses it to clear Jodah's madness.
Jodah and Jaya stop an uprising against King Darien by the Knights of Stromgald in Krov . Jodah allies Kjeldor and Balduvia against Lim-Dûl.
Lim-Dûl's hordes attack Kjeldor , leaving the Kjeldoran Hinterlands depopulated. Refugees from Mikkel , including Kaysa and Kolbjörn , flee south to Fyndhorn .

The Summit of the Null Moon takes place. Chromium Rhuell is killed, and Ravidel ascends. Faralyn flees to Shandalar , while Leshrac goes to fetch Lim-Dûl and Tevesh Szat goes to duel Jaeuhl Carthalion first.
Lim-Dûl's Battle - The alliance of Kjeldor and Balduvia defeats Lim-Dûl. At the end of the battle, Leshrac appears and takes the necromancer with him when he departs Dominaria.
Jaeuhl Carthalion defeats Tevesh Szat , and Szat flees to Shandalar.
Freyalise completes the World Spell and enchants Jodah's mirror.
The Shard of the Twelve Worlds is destroyed, and the Ice Age comes to an end.
The witches Tayva and Loria lose most of their powers and flee north, carrying a dark spirit in a severed head.

War for Shandalar - Faralyn is killed by the planeswalker Kenan Sahrmal . Lim-Dûl, Leshrac, and Tevesh-Szat battle against the plane's defenders, the plane's wild mana, and each other. Leshrac and Szat are eventually defeated, and they flee Shandalar while Lim-Dûl is left behind. Sahrmal's powers are severely drained.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Kristina leaves Taysir . Bitter, he takes the vengeful Ravidel as his apprentice. Taysir craves to return to Rabiah but can't because of Nailah 's spell. Ravidel pushes Taysir to kill the planeswalkers and use their energy to pierce the spell, just like Faralyn did to the Shard during the Summit.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Taysir hunts down Leshrac but cannot bring himself to kill him in cold blood, so he instead imprisons him in Phyrexia . Ravidel leaves Taysir for an unspecified amount of time.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Flooding of Terisiare - The Sea of Laments forms, and Terisiare is scattered into six main islands, becoming the Terisian Isles . Fyndhorn and Kelsinko are lost to the sea and repopulated by Viscerids . Jaeuhl Carthalion and Kaysa lead the Fyndhorn survivors to Yavimaya and make peace with Multani and the intelligent gorillas there.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Kjeldorans and Balduvians clash in Balesh Pass . The orcish General Groth Jonar turns on the Balduvian mage Elkan , killing him, and allows the enemy survivors to withdraw back to Kjeldor .
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Lim-Dûl's War - Lim-Dûl attacks Shandalar with an army of the undead. Azar , Sahrmal's apprentice, defeats him but gets trapped with him in one body. Sahrmal hides the body, for its energies keep 'walkers from entering Shandalar.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Sahrmal names his second apprentice the Guardian and vanishes from Shandalar.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: The apprentice wizard Damon becomes a wizard and kills an attacking Agent of Stromgald .
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: The witches Tayva and Loria betray each other, and the dark spirit of the lake claims both of their lives.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Bonding over their war against the rogue general Varchild , Kjeldor and Balduvia unify, becoming the nation of New Argive .
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Fall of Soldev - Mairsil , possessing Jaya Ballard , destroys Soldev using Phyrexian War Beasts and Soldevi Steam Beasts . Jodah triggers Jaya's planeswalker spark using his mirror, destroying the remainder of Mairsil's spirit.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Fall of the School of the Unseen - the Phyrexian War Beasts and Soldevi Steam Beasts teleport to the School of the Unseen , wreaking absolute destruction on the college. The newly-ascended Jaya brings Jodah there, destroys the war beasts, and severs the school's bottomless pit.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: The Rimewind mage Heidar rises to power to try and reinstate the Ice Age with the help of Garza Zol . He kills Lovisa Coldeyes in his plans before being eliminated by his former ally.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: The Battle of Kjeldor occurs. Haakon is killed.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Aldon , exiled from his castle by Dreygar , summons dark creatures and a Serra Angel to aid him. Tempted by vengeance, he battles and defeats Dreygar, reclaiming his home but losing his angel.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Ravidel, wishing revenge on Leshrac, Tevesh Szat, Kristina, and all other people who once betrayed him, starts a long-term plan on Corondor.
paragraphs.section: The Flood Age (2934 AR to 3000 AR)

paragraphs.text: Ravidel battles Ash Warlord Embereck over the Golgothian Sylex. A bargain is struck, and Ravidel gains control of the sylex.
