paragraphs.text: The Gathering of the sages of Minorad . These sages, including Kristina of the Woods, Ash Warlord Embereck, Grenfell Mor of Golthonor , Altair of Coloni , and Liana of Minorad , are visited by Ravidel, who threatens them with the Golgothian Sylex. Embereck leaves the council. The others agree to Ravidel's demands: his plans will be left alone, whatever they are.

Ravidel banishes Kristina from the White Woods . Grenfell is locked in the sand seas of Golthonor . Altair wanders Corondor for ages. Liana is left under the mind control of Ravidel's spell squire, the Scarlet Vizier . The Vizier talks his way into House Carthalion, hoping that one day, a child with the planeswalker's spark will be born in this family of powerful mages, and the child will overthrow Ravidel.
Start of the Common Era ( CE ) reckoning in Almaaz .
Midsummer eve — The Parting on Cridhe - Malvos arranges for Nohr to break the Clan Tree of Cridhe , creating a chasm splitting the island in two and cursing the line of Nohr for 520 years.
The buried city of old Sumifa is discovered in the desert a bit east of the modern capital of Sumifa.
The icy queendom of Drufalden , last of the Rigida , is ended by a song-spell cast by Ogwater Rifkin .
Ogwater releases the Beast of the Hours from beneath Sarraza and banishes it, destroying the Chimes in the process.
The first Festival of Estark is held, with Kuthuman as Grandmaster of the Arena.
The Dominarian city of Soltari vanishes from the plane, transported to Rath but left partially stuck in the ether space between worlds.
Johan is reported to be Emperor of Tirras .

Urza and Xantcha arrive on Equilor , hoping to learn the origins of the Phyrexians. Urza learns the nature of the Shard and thinks his crusade to protect his world from Phyrexia has ended. He plans to create an artifact-based paradise on Equilor until the Elders tell him the Shard has fallen and Dominaria is left vulnerable to Phyrexian influence once more. Urza and Xantcha leave Equilor and travel for 100 years to reach Dominaria.
c. 3146 ( "many years after" 2946 )

The Wizards' War - after many years, Lim-Dûl finally drives Azar 's soul from his decaying body and emerges from the grave Kenan Sahrmal had put him in. He finds that Shandalar has powerful defenders now - the Guardian and his five first guildlords. Lim-Dûl nevertheless starts the war and this time loses soundly. The Black guildlord dies in this war, leaving the guild leaderless.
To protect the Great Barrier, the Guardian removes Lim-Dûl's soul from Azar's body and puts it in an artifact - the Chain Veil .
Azar's now soulless body reanimates by residual necromantic magic and names itself the lichlord Skavius Slan . It takes over the vacant position as the Black Guild's guildlord.
Ugin and Azor meet to discuss a plan to trap and destroy Nicol Bolas.
Ravi meets Sengir while they are both children.

The Great War ends - The Tolgath and the Ancients have been warring on Ulgrotha for an unknown period of time. Ravi ends this war by ringing the Apocalypse Chime , which destroys the leylines of Ulgrotha, kills nearly everything on the plane, and weakens the planar barriers between Dominaria and Kamigawa . Ravi herself becomes trapped in a coffin for 220 years, driving her insane.

The Kami War begins: On the night of his daughter's birth, Konda uses Hisoka 's research and the soratami 's aid to take Kyodai from the spirit realm and lock her into the form of a stone disc that makes Konda immortal. This enrages O-Kagachi , the mightiest of kami, and he starts sending kami to attack the mortal realm.
Urza and Xantcha arrive on Dominaria from Equilor and begin looking for Phyrexian sleeper agents .
Toshi meets Hidetsugu . They form the Hyozan Reckoners .
Kobo is apprenticed to Hidestugu.
An unnamed queen in Madara seizes power over the entire island chain, becoming the first empress of the Empire of Madara .

Michiko Konda sets out to discover her involvement at the beginning of the Kami War. Toshiro Umezawa gets involved in Mochi 's plans. Michiko, Toshi, and their companions are captured by the Orochi of the Myojin of Life's Web , who want to kill Michiko to end the war. They escape and Toshi allies himself with the Myojin of Night's Reach to defeat Life's Web.

Enraged over the death of his apprentice Kobo at the hands of Choryu , who was taking orders from the wizards of Minamo and the Moonfolk , Hidestugu launches an attack on Minamo Academy and the moonfolk capital Oboro .

O-Kagachi finally manifests in the physical world and demolishes Eiganjo . Toshi brings That Which Was Taken to Minamo to set O-Kagachi against Mochi. The fallen samurai rise as spirits, and Konda leads them to reclaim That Which Was Taken.

Hidetsugu is sent to the lair of the Oni of All-Consuming Chaos and merges with it. Toshi takes That Which Was Taken from Mochi again and brings it to Michiko, who frees Kyodai from it. The two of them defeat O-Kagachi, Konda, and Mochi and leave to form the new O-Kagachi.

Toshi is taken to Dominaria and blinded by the Myojin of Night's Reach as punishment for indirectly recreating the planar barriers around Kamigawa , denying the Myojin her planeswalking abilities. Toshi survives and starts the Umezawa lineage .
Orcs and goblins that survived the ringing of the Apocalypse Chime form a kingdom in the Koskun Mountains .
Sheoltun Occupation - having conquered all of Aerona and the Spice Isles , the Sheoltun Empire invades Terisiare.
Xantcha meets Ratepe and has him pose as Mishra .
Jodah visits Urza and brings him to his senses.
Urza kills all Sleeper Agents on Dominaria .
Sacrifice at Koilos - Urza fights Gix in the Caves of Koilos . Xantcha and Ratepe die.
Azor travels to Ixalan . He never receives the signal from Ugin to imprison Nicol Bolas using the Immortal Sun and is left stranded.
Uprising in Epityr - the Sheoltun Empire begins to collapse after being routed from Terisiare by a flock of Serra Angels summoned by the songmage Thabit .
Alesha chooses her war name.
Alesha becomes khan of the Mardu Horde .
Nicol Bolas corrupts Yasova Dragonclaw .
Sarkhan arrives from the Nexus of Fate to what is for him 1280 years into Tarkir's past.
In a battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas , Bolas coerces Tarkir's dragon broods to attack their progenitor. Ugin is defeated and left for dead.

Sarkhan encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon, putting him in a healing stasis. His fate fulfilled, Sarkhan vanishes back to his own time. Over time, Tarkir's dragonstorms increase in frequency and ferocity.
The rakshasa and naga forsake the Sultai Brood . Tasigur surrenders to Silumgar .
Daghatar decides to ally with Dromoka and her brood, forcing the Abzan Houses to give up ancestor worship. The Remembrance is destroyed, and every kin-tree is uprooted.

Khanfall - Shu Yun , khan of the Jeskai Way ; Alesha , khan of the Mardu; Reyhan , leader of the Abzan holdouts; Yasova, khan of the Temur Frontier ; and Tasigur hold a meeting at Dirgur stronghold to discuss the future of their clans. Tasigur betrays the location to the Dragonlords. Reyhan is killed by Silumgaar. Shu Yun and the other Ghostfire initiates of the Jeskai give up their lives to make peace with Ojutai . Alesha, Yasova, and Tasigur escape.
Tasigur returns to Silumgar and is turned into a piece of jewelry for the dragon.
Alesha and the Mardu decide to forsake their previous clan and follow Dragonlord Kolaghan .
Yasova and the Temur begin hunting food for Atarka .
The Founding of the Tolarian Academy - To combat the Phyrexians , Urza and Barrin establish the Tolarian Academy as a place to research, plan, and train for the plane's defenses.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Baishya receives a vision from Ugin and journeys with her twin Naiva , grandmother Yasova and Ghostfire Warrior Tae Jin to the spirit dragon's tomb. There, they outwit Nicol Bolas , tricking him into fleeing Tarkir and keeping Ugin’s survival hidden.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Jhoira becomes a pupil at the Tolarian Academy
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Urza summons a dragon modeled after the Shivan dragon Mg'razzgh to inspire his artificial dragon for Tolaria's defense, but the dragon deceives him into granting enough power to break free from its binding.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Karn is built and given life at the Tolarian Academy by Urza and Barrin .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Tolarian Temporal Disaster - Phyrexians overrun the Tolarian Academy and kill everyone. Karn is sent 24 hours back in time to stop this, but the academy is destroyed when Urza's time machine is overloaded. Urza , Barrin , Karn and a dozen students escape the island, moving the Academy to the ship New Tolaria . The sleeper agent Kerrick is locked in a fast-time bubble. Several survivors stay on the island.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Founding of New Vodalia - Galina emerges from the time stream , defeats the council of Etlan Shiis , and establishes herself as Empress of New Vodalia .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Urza , Barrin , and Karn return to Tolaria and are reunited with Jhoira , who is the last survivor on the island. They start rebuilding the academy.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: After a disastrous attack on the Phyrexian gorge where K'rrik is building his army, Jhoira falls into a coma.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Hazezon Tamar and Adira Strongheart get married.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Robaran Mercenaries plunder the ship of a prince from Corondor . They make away with a lot of fine loot. Hazezon Tamar gets rich from selling the goods and settles in Bryce , becoming its governor. Adira Strongheart breaks up with him, preferring to remain a sand pirate. She settles in Palmyra , while Hunding Gjornersen sets off on his travels alone.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The rebuilding of the Tolarian Academy finishes. Jhoira wakes up after 10 years in a coma and saves Teferi from the slow-time bubble he had been caught in ever since the destruction of the academy.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Johan's War : The Battle of Bryce is started by Emperor Johan of Tirras with troops led by Xira Arien , but they are beaten back by Jaeger Ojanen and Hazezon Tamar . They travel to Palmyra and recruit Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries and stop a second attack in the Battle of Palmyra. However, Jaeger is eaten by a sand wurm .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Johan reaches Efrava and meets Jedit Ojanen , Jaeger's son. The sorcerer's plan to use Jedit to kill Hazezon and Adira backfires, and Johan is forced to flee to Shauku 's castle in Arboria . Jedit and Adira's intervention destroys the castle, but Johan escapes back to Tirras.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Johan builds a fleet of airships to conquer Efrava, while Jedit rediscovers his people's origins in Scarwood . Jedit gathers allies, with three or four cat warrior tribes, elves , and people from Arboria joining him. In the Battle of Efrava, Johan kills Adira and is then knocked overboard by Jedit and eaten by a sand wurm. Jedit becomes the commander of the Robaran Mercenaries, and the cat warriors are free to roam Dominaria.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Day of Falcons - Urza attacks K'rrik 's Phyrexian gorge with hundreds of razor falcons. Although they kill more than half of the Phyrexians, they are eventually defeated. Urza himself falls into the gorge and is only rescued by the combined forces of his falcons, Karn , and Barrin in his ornithopter .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: A Phantom Monster accidentally summoned by Barrin kills the student Skaven before being dispelled by Urza .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Arzakon discovers Shandalar and tries to invade it, but is repelled by the Great Barrier, reinforced by The Guardian .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Arzakon's War - Arzakon corrupts the five guildlords of Shandalar, who turn on the Guardian and kill his body. The Guardian's spirit warns one of the plane's spellcasters, who raises a defense and defeats the guildlords and Arzakon himself, locking the planeswalker out of Shandalar for an untold number of years.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Urza journeys to Shiv and locates the Mana Rig . Uniting the Shivan viashino and goblins , Urza has the Mana Rig create the Legacy artifacts.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Invasion of Tolaria begins - K'rrik 's forces start escaping from their gorge and attacking the Tolarians.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Bloodline Project is started in secret by Urza shortly after his visit to Shiv .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Urza travels to Yavimaya to find allies against Phyrexia but is imprisoned in an ancient tree for his crimes against Argoth .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Teferi travels to his homeland of Zhalfir and helps end a civil war there.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: After five years of imprisonment in Yavimaya , Urza escapes and brings with him the spirit of Multani to the besieged Tolaria . He also brings the Shivans, including the two dragons Rhammidarigaaz and Gherridarigaaz , to fight the Phyrexians . The Invasion of Tolaria is defeated, and K'rrik is killed.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Multani realizes that the Phyrexians are a threat that only Urza can deal with. To aid in the war effort, he grants Urza the Weatherseed .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Collapse of Serra's Realm - Urza defeats Radiant in Serra's Realm and drains the fading plane's energy into the power matrix of the Weatherlight . Captaining the skyship, Jhoira carries hundreds of Serran refugees to Zhalfir .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: In Zhalfir, Teferi proposes to Jhoira , but she politely declines.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Riand steals Maraavis 's egg on Urza 's behalf to create the Metathran . Maraavis punishes Riand with a 1,000-day death illusion.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: A 12-year old Gatha comes to Tolaria with high personal ambition.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Urza involves Barrin in the Bloodline project , although he keeps its true scope and history secret.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Urza reveals his Bloodline project publicly, and puts most of Tolaria 's resources to working on it. Rayne and Gatha are recruited as scholars for the project.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Croag , a Phyrexian Inner Circle member, is awakened by Yawgmoth to hunt down Urza . He starts sending Negators after Urza.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Davvol of Coracin betrays his own people and is recruited by Phyrexia .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Serra arrives on Ulgrotha after about 100 years of interplanar travel. She unites the nomad tribes into the city-state of Aysen .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Some dwarves go through an interplanar portal and end up on Ulgrotha. They found the city New Freedom . Some of these dwarves set out across the ocean to explore their new world.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Two planeswalkers fight in Ulgrotha, and Baron Sengir is left behind in the duel's wake. Sengir overtakes New Freedom and turns its princess, Irini , into a vampire.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sengir discovers his childhood acquaintance Ravi locked in a vault on top of the Basalt Spire and now insane. He frees her and adopts her as a member of his family.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Multani returns to Yavimaya aboard the Weatherlight after decades abroad. Rofellos is brought along to help craft the forest's defenses against Phyrexia.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Croag takes Davvol to Rath and makes him the artificial plane's new steward.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: To remove Karn 's progressive depression, Urza has Rayne cap the golem's memory at 20 years.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Fed up with mounting restrictions, Gatha leaves Tolaria to start his Bloodline project elsewhere, initially heading home to New Argive .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: c. 3455 (just over 150 years before the events of Legends Cycle II )
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Nicol Bolas usurps the power in Madara , becoming its new god-emperor.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: After 12 years of rejection across the world, Gatha arrives in Keld and finds a place there, enhancing their warriors through eugenics experiments.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Svogthir 's reign as guild leader of the Golgari is ended when the Sisters of Stone Death usurp his throne and claim the leadership.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Founding of Benalia - Torsten von Ursus establishes the new nation of Benalia based around the fallen Sheoltun capital of Benfosa.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: After 40 years of experiments in Keld , Gatha 's patron Trohg bids him create a witch king son.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: 133 years after his betrayal of Coracin , Davvol receives a new mission from Croag : improve upon the failing negators in order to kill Urza .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Shandalar's planar barrier fails, allowing planeswalkers to travel to and from the plane once again.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Feroz arrives on Ulgrotha. He meets Sandruu , a minotaur whom he trains in the use of magic. He also meets Serra. Serra and Feroz fall in love. After meeting the two planeswalkers, Baron Sengir decides to lie low for a while.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Ob Nixilis becomes a planeswalker and gets corrupted by the Chain Veil on Shandalar .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Nahiri awakens, fights the Eldrazi , desparks Nixilis with a hedron and traps him on Zendikar, and begins her search for Sorin .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sorin's Betrayal - Sorin Markov creates Avacyn and the Helvault . When Nahiri arrives to confront him about his failure to aid her, he imprisons her inside the Helvault.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Liesa and her entire Flight of Dusk are killed by Avacyn after they side with a demon lord .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Saint Traft is tricked and killed by the demon Withengar , but returns as a holy geist .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Mending of the Clan Tree on Cridhe - The Mender, Aylith of Inys Haen , heals Nazir of Inys Nohr , and together they end centuries of division, restoring balance after the devastating Parting and ushering in a new era of peace.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: In protest of the Bloodlines project, Timein leaves the Tolarian Academy to live with the Bloodlines subjects in the Colony.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sandruu ascends. During his travels, he meets Kristina, and they become romantically involved.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Feroz visits the Floating Isle and creates the Wizards' School there.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Ravidel shows Taysir the lovers Sandruu and Kristina. Taysir attacks Sandruu and follows him to Ulgrotha. Sandruu is banished to some faraway plane. Feroz kills Taysir but saves his Centre of Consciousness. Feroz gives the remnant of Taysir to the Anaba spirit crafters for cleansing.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Feroz's Ban is created - Serra and Feroz make Ulgrotha invisible and unreachable to exterior planeswalkers .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Aysen Abbey is built in the city of Onella .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Autumn Willow comes into being on Ulgrotha , gaining sentience from the influx of mana caused by Feroz's Ban .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Terena ’s quest to heal her father Aedhan leads to her brother Beothach ’s death and an unexpected pregnancy, securing her rule over the Llanowar elfhame of Ruadach for 600 years.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Ramirez DePietro is murdered by Halfdane , who takes on his appearance.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: c. 3607 (almost 400 years after the first empress of Madara rose to power )
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Wasitora discovers other nekoru and becomes their queen after defeating her rivals. After mating with Mayonako , she departs to raise her litter elsewhere, drawn westward by the promise of Madaran fish.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Madara-Edemi War begins when Argenti and Kusho defect from the Madaran Empire. Ramses Overdark attempts to retake the islands but is thwarted by Tetsuo Umezawa .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Marhault Elsdragon leads a major campaign against Argenti and Kusho. After bringing both islands to a near-full defeat, Ramses has Elsdragon killed and rises to power.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Argenti and Kusho are liberated. Ramses Overdark's manor is destroyed by Kolo Meha . Ayesha Tanaka and Tor Wauki the Younger kill Halfdane . Tetsuo Umezawa slays Xira Arien , Jorgan Hage , Ramses Overdark and Nicol Bolas , ending the Madara-Edemi War .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: An-Havva is built on the edge of the Great Wood on Ulgrotha .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Eron the Relentless steals a book of magic from Grandmother Sengir for the Wizard Savant Bernatheen . In exchange, Bernatheen casts an immortality spell on Eron. Furious at this outcome, Baron Sengir turns Bernatheen into a Greater Werewolf .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Hurloon minotaur Hamu rescues the pregnant human acrobat Ikenet , whose Horn Dancing sparks human-minotaur coexistence in Hurloon.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Teferi establishes the Creeds of Zhalfir and leaves to travel the planes.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The refugees from Serra's Realm arrive in Benalia and establish the village of Devas .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Urza gets Clan Capashen involved in the Bloodline project .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Inheriting the superior genetic make-up created by Gatha , Kreig cows or kills his rivals and becomes the supreme ruler of Keld .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Femeref secedes from Zhalfir .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Croag and Davvol discover rogue Phyrexian genes in certain individuals, including in Clan Capashen members in Benalia .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Jolrael apprentices as a mage within Zhalfir. She soon grows disillusioned and leaves for the Mwonvuli Jungle .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sleeper agents in Askaranton discover that Keldon warriors led by Kreig have traces of Phyrexian genetics.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Wishing to cull the Phyrexian genetics from Keld and Benalia , Croag and Davvol spend many years sending troops from Rath to attack the two nations.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Torrezon splits into three kingdoms, beginning the Apostasine Wars.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Ihsan visits Baron Sengir. He wants to be turned into a vampire so he has the strength to kill the Baron, but Sengir is on to him and turns him into a Shade instead.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Feroz dies in a lab accident. Serra leaves Ulgrotha and is killed on Dominaria by an unnamed planeswalker who wants her ring. In her passing, she blesses the land of Sursi to create a sanctuary against the dark forces that assailed her followers.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Brother Angus starts building the Cathedral of Serra .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Taysir is resurrected by the Anaba with a cleansed and peaceful mind but a withered body.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: At some point between 3780 and 4180
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Taysir meets the orphaned Daria and raises her as his own daughter.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Feroz's Ban collapses, leaving Ulgrotha visible and accessible to planeswalkers once more.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Centuries after her creation, time starts being counted in years of Avacyn on the plane of Innistrad . This is possibly the official date for the founding of the Church of Avacyn.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Civic guildmage Sabul Hajeen summons the angel Kotara to Ki'pamu take revenge on his brother's killers. This escalates to the point where the killer's family summons a demon of the pit. Kotara and the demon kill each other, and Sabul repents of his quest for vengeance.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The wizard Majaliwa aids Commander Qalhata in Zhalfir ’s war against Femeref , summoning a devastating wind dragon, but this allows the spirit of Gazali to possess Majaliwa, casting his soul into the void.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Suq'Ata annexes parts of Zhalfir, and Zhalfir dissolves into several independent city-states.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sabul Hajeen 's uncle Tartesk Hajeen summons a Hand of Justice to fight crime in Ki’pamu , but it turns against the city's poor. Forced to act, Sabul allies with necromancer Jhossendea Ilmiera , banishing the avatar and beginning to heal their families' old feud.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Elder Dragons of Arcavios end the Blood Age and found Strixhaven , beginning the Mystic Age.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Croag leads a major attack on Keld, where Gatha and Kreig both are killed. Croag himself is seriously injured, but Phyrexia gains access to the ruins of Gatha's laboratory and learns of the Bloodline Project .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Teferi returns to Dominaria and reunites Zhalfir under queen Yormeba .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Teferi travels to the Chaza Isles to start his temporal experiments. The island he set his lab up on becomes known as Teferi's Isle .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: c. 3995 ("some two hundred years" before the Mirage War )
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Phasing of Teferi's Isle - Teferi accidentally phases out Teferi's Isle and himself with it. Mangara , Jolrael , and Kaervek all notice their absence and meet each other on what is left of the island.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: A tavern in Argivia is attacked by the lovesick Edgur in bearform . Edgur is among those who are killed.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Apostasine Wars enter an interregnum ceasefire.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: From an autopsy of a negator , Rayne , Barrin and Urza learn the Phyrexians are targeting members of the Bloodline Project specifically.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Rofellos fights Phyrexians in Yavimaya while Davvol overlaps it with Rath. Rofellos briefly enters the plane, learning of its existence.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: With the information from Rofellos, Urza planeswalks to Rath. There, he meets Lyna of the Soltari , and they share plans.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Croag murders Davvol for his failures and for his treacherous plans.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: On Rath , Mocklen il-Dal orchestrates Light-General Rogur 's downfall, exposing his war crimes and ensuring a public execution.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Galin, later known as Garth , is born.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Autumn — The Night of Fire : House of Oor-tael in Kush is destroyed by Zarel Ewine and the other four houses of Kush. Cullinarn is killed. Kuthuman becomes a planeswalker, and Zarel Ewine takes Kuthuman's place as the new Grandmaster of the Arena.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Rise of the Cabal - Virot Maglan founds the Otarian Cabal and becomes its patriarch.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Greensleeves is born.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sparrow Hawk is born.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Elenda of Garrano returns from Ixalan , ending the Apostasine Wars. She gives the gift of vampirism to her people and is named a saint. The Church of Dusk unites power with Queen Miralda of Torrezon, forming the Legion of Dusk . Torrezon becomes a powerful kingdom and begins expanding outward.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Autumn — The Time of Troubles : Garth returns to Kush and causes large-scale havoc in the city, leading to the city's transformation into Estark. Jimak Ravelth , Tulan , Uriah Aswark , Varnel Buckara , Zarel Ewine , and thousands of others are killed. Garth's planeswalker spark ignites. Varena becomes the Grand Master of the Arena .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Late Winter — The Stone Brain falls in the Whispering Woods northwest of White Ridge .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Spring — Destruction of White Ridge . The wizard Towser attempts to sacrifice Greensleeves to steal her power, but his plans are thwarted by Gull , Lily , and Greensleeves herself. The three vow to form an army to fight evil wizards.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Early Winter — Norreen is kidnapped and blackmailed by Sabriam of Benalia into killing Gull and Greensleeves , but she instead joins their army and becomes its commander.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Winter — Before dying of old age, Chaney trains Greensleeves in the ways of nature magic. Greensleeves becomes a druid.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Greensleeves activates the Stone Brain and starts subduing and "tagging" evil wizards to stop them from doing any harm. The tagged wizards include Karli , Haakon , and Dacian .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: After the rescue of their son from Benalia City , Garth swears to Norreen to resume his family duties and stop planeswalking.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: c. 4075 ("Within a century" after discovering Teferi's Isle )
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Mangara's Harmony begins - Mangara becomes one of the most powerful men in Zhalfir and even Jamuraa through politics.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Battle of Lat-Nam - Greensleeves , Gull , and Sparrow Hawk are reunited. Greensleeves becomes a planeswalker , but she sacrifices her spark to heal the poisoned and ill land of Lat-Nam island. She is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Betrayal of Tamingazin - King Tagard Tarngold is assassinated, and Suderbod invades the Valley of Tamingazin after the theft of the Magewall Hub . The Valley is ultimately saved when Aligarius Timni restores the Magewall just as the Suder forces are on the brink of victory.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The goblins of the Flarg destroy themselves in a civil war. Their ruins are later excavated by scholars from the Argivian University.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: After serving a Lord of the Pit named Vincent as his chef for seven years, the wizard Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar ’s cookbook becomes unexpectedly popular in the overworld. Upon her release, she is hunted by the very creatures she once deemed delicious.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: c. 4160 (A few centuries before c. 4560)
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Skoti overthrow the Einir as gods of Kaldheim
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Starke and Greven il -Vec are born.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: c. 4162 or earlier (a little before 395 BD)
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Legion of Dusk marches from Alta Torrezon under the banner of Saint Elenda of Garrano , beginning its conquest of the continent of Torrezon.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Goblin War - the empire of Oneah is destroyed by a goblin invasion.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Gerrard Capashen is born.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Phyrexia invades Benalia . Karn rescues Gerrard and brings him to Sidar Kondo in Jamuraa .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Spring — Jared Carthalion is born.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Autumn — Battle of Aster Fall - Adam Carthalion dies fighting Ravidel , destroying the planeswalker's barge with his final spell. His son, Jared Carthalion, survives but is physically altered and unrecognized as an heir.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: In Savaea , the elven Elder Leaf attempts to mediate with Red Mountains goblin chieftess Kruuna , offering wisdom about life and death, but Kruuna mortally wounds her and is, in turn killed by Leaf's elves.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Heart of Shanodin reveals Ittono Khairt ni Hata Kan ’s lost Onean self and Daisilodavi ’s changeable nature. Daisilodavi kills their target, Lord Glinham , as well as a Shanodin dryad beguiling Khairt. Bound by fate and blood, the two return to King Amjad together.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Hanna and Orim are born. Hanna is the last known individual born of the Bloodline Project , marking its end.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Mirtiin Rebellion ends with the defeat of King Myrrax and the execution of his followers, placing the Mirtiin under the strict control of the Stahaan . However, covert resistance against the Stahaan rule quietly persists.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: A 12-year old Crovax encounters Selenia for the first time. He learns that she is bound to his father's service, locked inside an amulet that must be broken to free her.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Ravidel discovers Jared Carthalion living as a street urchin in Arathoxia and begins to send creatures after him.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sisay becomes a cabin 'boy' aboard a pirate ship after being freed from a slaver ship.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Zhalfirin crew of the Pirate ship Wavecrester discover Steel Island , and are narrowly defeated by its mechanical Gnome inhabitants.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: A 15-year old Vuel fails his rite of maturity because Starke meddles in it. He leaves the Kondo clan and, influenced by Starke, steals the Legacy from the 14-year-old Gerrard Capashen .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Vuel deactivates Karn with the Touchstone , which is left stuck in the golem's frozen grasp. Vuel sets about scattering the Legacy artifacts across Dominaria.
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Vuel wages war against his father, Sidar Kondo , and kills him. He also wars against Multani . Phyrexia approaches Vuel and makes him the new Evincar of Rath : Volrath .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sisay starts collecting the scattered bits of the Legacy .
paragraphs.section: War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: After a crash in the Talruum Mountains , Tahngarth joins the crew of the Skyship Weatherlight under Sisay.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sisay and Tahngarth search the ruins of Oneah and discover the location of the Juju Bubble . They travel to the Adarkar Wastes and find the Juju Bubble in an underground ruin, but an ancient war beast activates and kills first mate Meida . Tahngarth is promoted to be the new first mate.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Summer – Mangara's Harmony ends with Mangara 's imprisonment in the Amber Prison by Kaervek . The Mirage War begins.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Summer – A Spirit of the Night assassinates Femeref 's Council of Voices. Asmira assumes the role of the nation's spiritual leader and military leader, or Sidar.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Early autumn - Fall of Arathoxia - Ravidel attacks the city-state of Arathoxia , leaving the city in ruins and many of his enemies dead, but survivors like Jared Carthalion and Liana of Minorad escape his wrath.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Autumn – After the defeat of Coldraith , the Nightmare Caliphear frees Altair's mind from Ravidel 's curse in exchange for 10 years of his servitude.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Rashida 's village is attacked by dragons. She vows to wipe them out, slaying over a dozen herself and earning the name "Scalebane" for the banesword she carries and, later, herself.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Early winter - Fall of Castle Melmereth - Jared and Lilana confront Ravidel inside Castle Melmereth and summon a Shivan Dragon , destroying the castle at the cost of several lives. Despite Ravidel's survival, the event shatters his control over Corondor .
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Late Winter – After meeting her in Hamath , Jared is apprenticed to Kristina of the Woods .
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Deep Spring – Kristina and Jared discover Ravidel is fighting Liana over the Moxen . Liana gives them to Jared and fights Ravidel in the Abyss , where she is killed.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Autumn – Jared and Kristina meet Grenfell Mor , who's been working on a spell to deactivate the Golgothian Sylex. Jared and Kristina become lovers.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Autumn – Caliphear and Altair join Jared and Kristina, and they attack Ravidel. The sylex is destroyed, but Ravidel gets away with the Moxen, and Altair is killed.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Mirage War ends. Asmira sacrifices herself to free Mangara , and Kaervek is imprisoned in his place. Teferi repairs the timeline.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Early Winter – Activation of the Mox Beacon - Ravidel activates the Mox Beacon , summoning many planeswalkers to Corondor. Daria is the first to arrive, the moment Jared ascends.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Justina Carthalion is born.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: The Planeswalker War - Ravidel assembles a device, greatly weakening the many planeswalkers that were summoned by the Mox Beacon to Corondor . They start battling each other across the continent to retrieve their powers. The war destroys parts of Corondor, including the cities of Shikar , Telemar , and Hamath , and leads to the deaths of Embereck and Grenfell Mor , and possibly Ravidel .
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: After losing a dagger-throwing contest to Sisay , Gerrard Capashen , Mirri , and Rofellos join the Weatherlight Crew .
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Astor becomes a Keldon Warlord.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Crovax steals Selenia away from his father's mansion in Urborg and travels to Zhalfir . In Port City, he discovers the Skyship Weatherlight docked, and after a quick duel with Tahngarth , he joins their crew.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Attack on Crovax's Estate - Phyrexians led by Gallowbraid and Morinfen attack Crovax 's home. With a warning from Selenia , the Weatherlight Crew travels to Urborg and joins the battle. Crovax attempts to free Selenia, but she is claimed by Volrath . Rofellos is killed by Gallowbraid during the battle. Upset, Gerrard, Crovax, and Mirri all leave the crew.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Sisay and the remaining Weatherlight Crew continue collecting the Legacy , picking up Karn and the Touchstone . She learns that Vuel has become Volrath.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Astor kills Skouras the dragon.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Abduction of Sisay - With the aid of Starke , Volrath abducts Sisay . The Weatherlight crew picks up Gerrard , Ertai , Starke , Mirri , and Crovax and planeshifts to Rath.
paragraphs.section: The War Years (4195 AR to 4205 AR) [ 17 ]

paragraphs.text: Assault on Rath - the Weatherlight crew frees Sisay. Crovax kills Selenia , placing the curse of vampirism on himself. Crovax kills Mirri. Ertai and Crovax are left on Rath. The Weatherlight leaves for Mercadia .
Revolution on Mercadia - the Weatherlight crew defeats the Phyrexians in Mercadia , overthrow the ruling caste of Kyren , and return to Dominaria .
Crovax's Coronation - Crovax is named the new Evincar of Rath . Belbe and Volrath are killed, and Ertai is corrupted by the Phyrexians .

Prophecy War - Keld invades Jamuraa , but through the actions of Teferi , Barrin , and others, Jamuraa wins, and the invading Keldons are eradicated. Rayne is killed by Greel , who in turn is killed by Barrin .
The Phyrexian Invasion starts. Benalia is destroyed, Llanowar is severely damaged, and Takara en-Dal is killed.
The Phasing Out of Zhalfir occurs. Orim makes an immunity serum for the plague. Teferi phases out Shiv , and Urza assembles the Nine Titans . Hanna dies from the Phyrexian plague.
The Obliteration of Tolaria - A grief-maddened Barrin commits suicide by annihilating all of Tolaria.

The Argivian scholar Godwyn is captured and Compleated by the Phyrexians. Godwyn then leads a conquest across New Argive, killing everyone in Elbreth , Calum , Toribah , and then Argivia itself. He is then betrayed and killed by his second-in-command, the Compleated woman Kari .
The Battle of Koilos takes place. Thaddeus is killed. The portal to Phyrexia is closed.
The Rathi Overlay happens. The Stronghold arrives in Urborg , and Skyshroud appears in Keld . Crovax kills Tsabo Tavoc .
The Keldon Twilight happens, destroying the Keldon Necropolis and bringing Eladamri and Sivvi to Urborg aboard the Golden Argosy .

Tevesh Szat gets Darigaaz to make the Primevals rise again, and they turn against the world's mortals. Karn talks sense into Darigaaz. Darigaaz dives into a volcano to break the link of the Primevals. Rith and Crosis are imprisoned again, while Dromar and Treva are chased off.

The Counterattack on Phyrexia begins. Tevesh Szat betrays the Nine Titans and kills Kristina and Daria . Urza kills Szat and powers the soul bombs . However, Urza starts to listen to Yawgmoth 's whispers. He defects, joins Phyrexia and kills Taysir .

The Predator is sent smashing into the Stronghold and is destroyed. Gerrard and Squee are captured by Ertai. The Weatherlight is severely damaged and put out of commission. Crovax sends Gerrard to Phyrexia.
Gerrard battles and decapitates Urza, then wounds Yawgmoth, who is masquerading as Hanna , and is pushed back to the Stronghold . Gerrard kills Crovax while Squee kills Ertai.
Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to the borders of Urborg.
The Gutting of Phyrexia - The remaining four Titans activate the soul bombs, and Phyrexia is almost fully destroyed.

The Black Cloud of Death - Yawgmoth enters Dominaria as a death cloud. Karn discovers a new way to read the Thran Tome . Weatherlight is reborn. Eladamri , Lin Sivvi , Bo Levar , and Commodore Guff die, along with what is surely billions of Dominarians. Dwarves make the volcano in which the Stronghold is now situated erupt, destroying much of the Citadel as well as Yawgmoth's sanctum on Phyrexia. The Legacy is completed. Yawgmoth is slain by the combined power of The Legacy. Karn ascends.

In the aftermath, the Eliterates find the Vodalian Empire shattered, its soldiers dead or in hiding. Amid rising tensions, the disillusioned actor Destry poses as the high-ranking officer Omen , guiding the survivors toward peace before vanishing by faking his death.

Balthor Rockfist encounters Matoc , and together, they sail to their home continent of Otaria . In Auror , Balthor passes a trial and successfully joins Matoc's tribe. As thanks, Balthor forges a new sword for Matoc from the metal of a staff he found on the battlefield, which had belonged to Urza .
Freyalise erects the Martyrs' Tomb .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Tanhgarth, Sisay, and Squee get a new ship. Orim marries Cho-Manno .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Between 4207 and 4500
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Leshrac frees the Weaver King from the Stronghold.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Yavimaya is attacked by fake Phyrexians , summoned by the elf Zorich to kill human refugees. Zorich and Ereth summon a Thorn Elemental , which turns on the druids and kills them. Ereth sacrifices herself to kill Zorich, but centuries later, Zorich is remembered as a hero by the Yavimana humans, while Ereth has been forgotten.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: A morphling posing as the hero Flyn LaRouxe tricks the border town of Sylvayn out of the villagers' money for hunting a fake chimera . The drunkard Oly exposes the ruse, but the embarrassed villagers let Flyn go—with their money.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: A band of dragon hunters led by the enthralled pixie Vaan almost manage to destroy the dragon engine Zumaki , but it reconstructs itself after they leave, thinking it dead.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Laquatus betrays the Berbous Mer Empire, allowing Aboshan and his cephalid empire to take over the rule of the waters around the continent of Otaria .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: After the herd watchman Alcric and many cattle are killed by a Vampiric Dragon that kills for pleasure, Cabal overseer Buric has a demon summoned, and it and the dragon kill each other. Buric notes the upside: plenty of new meat for Cabal sausages.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Rasarm and his atog companion Yekol infiltrate Cabal lord Suarvol ’s mansion, rescuing Rasarm’s enslaved sister and killing Suarvol. Rasarm is arrested and kills Suarvol’s brother in the Arena of Aphetto , and then challenges and defeats their superior, Lord Flamescar . Rasarm is offered a choice by the Patriarch to either serve as a district lord or as an arena pit champion.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Selected Field Reports on the Kami are filed by Imperial Intercessors on Kamigawa .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The white dragon Eagyn rescues the little girl Pianna from northern barbarians and is killed fighting their leader. Kort swears he will protect the girl and induct her into the Northern Order of Otaria .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Karn sends out probes to various worlds. One of them lands in a ruined mansion on Otaria. This is the Mirari .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The Battle for the Mirari - soon afterwards, Chainer discovers the Mirari and brings it to the Cabal . Kirtar and Aboshan try to use the Mirari but are killed in the process.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Chainer overthrows the Cabal Patriarch . Kamahl kills Chainer. Cabal City is destroyed.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Balthor defeats Burke , becoming a zombie in the process. Kamahl goes into the Krosan Forest to look for Thriss .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Jeska is brought to Seton after a Mirari-influenced Kamahl strikes her. Kamahl kills the zombie Balthor and Laquatus . Kamahl becomes a druid and leaves the Mirari in Krosa. The Battle for the Mirari ends.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The Mirari's mutating waves spread across Otaria.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Rebirth of Karona - Akroma and Phage have their last battle in Averru . Many thousands of soldiers join each side. Kamahl slays Phage, Akroma, and Zagorka , and Karona is born.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Lowallyn is reincarnated in the form of Ixidor after he is freed from the deathwurm by Kamahl.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Karona destroys the Grand Coliseum and badly damages Eroshia .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Karona leaves Dominaria, leaving it without mana. Topos is destroyed by a lack of magic. Coliseum Island sinks. The Martyrs' Tomb is abandoned.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Karona's War - After a meeting with Karn on Argentum , Karona returns to Dominaria, where she destroys Aphetto , kills Llowalyn, Kuberr, and Averru, and razes Sanctum. Sash and Waistcoat kill Karona with the Mirari -sword.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Jeska ascends. Karn takes her to Argentum . Karn turns the Mirari into Memnarch , and he and Jeska leave to travel the planes together.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Before he leaves, a spot of glistening oil drips off Karn and is left behind on Argentum.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Memnarch spends decades studying Argentum's structure and form before he comes into contact with the glistening oil .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Corruption of Memnarch - inspired to make radical changes to the plane, Memnarch renames Argentum as Mirrodin .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Over the course of decades, Memnarch goes insane from his exposure to the glistening oil .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Memnarch's madness becomes so strong that it warps the plane's timeline compared to the Multiverse at large. Where only decades pass on other planes, Mirrodin sees centuries to millennia of development.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The Ur-Golems have a wondrous society on Mirrodin until Memnarch destroys them. The Ur-Golem pillars are erected in the Glimmervoid .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Memnarch brings many living things to Mirrodin via the Soul traps .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The glistening oil creates the Mycosynth and makes sure the line between artificial and natural creatures starts to blur on Mirrodin.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Memnarch thinks Karn visits him regularly, but that's just delusion talking. He subconsciously excludes the real Karn from Mirrodin.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Memnarch starts to want to become a planeswalker and launches the Moons of Mirrodin : gigantic artificial mana batteries that will power Mirrodin after it is turned into a machine to transfer the planeswalker's spark of one of Mirrodin's inhabitants into Memnarch.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Mavren Fein becomes a vampire .

paragraphs.text: Autumn — The Vendrell family, including a teenaged Marina Vendrell , moves into the House on Duskmourn . Soon after, she unwittingly provides the demon Valgavoth with four sacrifices, allowing him to begin expanding until he devours the entire plane, including both of its suns, within a handful of years.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Liliana Vess ascends as a planeswalker and the Lich Josu Vess is created from her brother's corpse.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The Fifth Dawn - The fifth and final moon of Mirrodin is launched, destroying the Radix and the Kaldra Champion, and beginning the Dawn Age of Mirrodin.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Yert dethrones and decapitates Geth . Glissa is lured to his domain and caught in a temporal trap while Slobad is captured by Memnarch .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Slobad is forced by Memnarch to create a memnite horde that destroys the mycosynth pillars and instead builds Mirrodin into a giant focus lens. Memnarch enters a stasis to remove his flesh.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The Mephidross expands rapidly. Raksha Golden Cub is exiled, and his cousin Yshkar becomes kha . Taj-Nar is destroyed, and the leonin abandon it and move to Krark-Home .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Glissa emerges from the temporal trap. The Battle of Krark-home begins.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: End of the Leveler War - Memnarch attempts to transfer Glissa's spark to his own body, but both die before the process is completed. All souls on the plane are sucked through the Ascension Web , and all life on Mirrodin ends. Slobad receives the souls, including Glissa's spark, and ascends. Karn returns to Mirrodin.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The Vanishing - Slobad gives up Glissa's spark to resurrect all people on Mirrodin. The older generations' souls depart from the plane, returning to their respective origin planes. The Panopticon is all but obliterated.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Karn turns Memnarch back into the Mirari. Slobad, Glissa, and the decapitated head of Geth are left on Mirrodin by Karn to guard the Mirari. Slobad is almost immediately killed by panicked goblins. Glissa flees into the heart of Mirrodin, where she is captured by Phyrexians and is compleated. Geth flees to the Mephidross and begins his partnership with Phyrexia.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The Nim Onslaught - Reawakened Nim massacre the surviving Moriok in an event known as the Nim Onslaught or Nim Massacre. By the end of the Onslaught, less than one-quarter of the pre-Vanishing Moriok are left alive on the plane.

paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: 1 Seleszeni – The Decamillennial of the Guildpact on Ravnica . Szadek 's machinations directly lead to the destruction of the magical Guildpact .
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: The Dissension - Rakdos , Project Kraj , and the Nephilim all attack the City of Ravnica . Momir Vig , Augustin IV , and Izolda are killed, and Jarad vod Savo is turned into a lich. Feather becomes new guildmaster of Boros , and Leonos II becomes Grand Arbiter of the Azorius . The Simic are leaderless for a time. Agyrem is overlaid onto Ravnica. A new, non-magical Guildpact, which is unsuccessful in maintaining the guilds' control, is written.
paragraphs.section: The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]

paragraphs.text: Temporal crisis of Dominaria - the collective impact of the Sylex Blast , the Tolarian Temporal Disaster , The Phasing of Zhalfir , the Rathi Overlay and Karona's Wara starts to be felt as mana-sucking time rifts begin to open all over Dominaria. Magic, time, and reality become increasingly unstable, and it is more difficult to planeswalk on Dominaria.

Teferi , Jhoira , and four Viashino and Ghitu return from their self-imposed exile to find Dominaria in a state of decay. Teferi begins work to try to return Shiv to Dominaria without further damaging the plane.
Using the unignited sparks of Radha and Venser , Nicol Bolas is revived.
Teferi gives up his spark to close the Shivan time rift.
Freyalise dies while closing the Skyshroud rift. Lord Windgrace imbues Urborg with his spirit and dies, closing the rift. Karn disappears after closing the Tolarian Rift.
Nicol Bolas destroys the Honden of Night's Reach and turns the Myojin's followers against her.

Jeska comes under the manipulation of Leshrac . She closes the rift over Zhalfir but ends up destroying Zhalfir in the process. She then closes the rift over Yavimaya but damages the ecosystem and drains Multani's lifeforce. She attempts to close the rift over Madara, but Leshrac's plot is revealed. He attacks Nicol Bolas with an artifact given to him by the Myojin of Night's Reach.

While chasing after Bolas, Leshrac sees Baron Sengir and Ihsan at the head of a great army of vampires preparing to walk through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir , leaving Grandmother Sengir behind on Ulgrotha . Leshrac and Bolas return to Dominaria.
Bolas beats Leshrac using the actual mask of Night's Reach. He uses an enthralled Leshrac to close the Madaran rift, then leaves for Amonkhet .
Jeska gives her life to close the final rift over Otaria .

The Great Mending takes place: all remaining fractures heal, first in Dominaria, then spreading throughout the Multiverse in a chain reaction. Mana again flows freely throughout Dominaria, returning life and hope to the dying world. Planeswalkers lose their immortality and godlike powers and much of their additional magical power. All existing means of traveling between planes without a spark cease to function.

paragraphs.text: Teferi sets out to become a mage of Suq'Ata. Jhoira meets Jodah again, and they start a relationship. Radha unifies the Keldons and the remaining Skyshroud Elves. Venser departs Dominaria to explore the planes.
