paragraphs.text: Fall of the Infinite Consortium - Jace defects from the Infinite Consortium and joins with Liliana Vess to dethrone Tezzeret as the organization's master. Tezzeret's inert form is picked up by Nicol Bolas .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: End of Diraden's Eternal Night - Chandra Nalaar and Gideon Jura defeat Diraden 's tyrant prince Velrav , and end his curse of everlasting darkness on the plane.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: After walking through the Purifying Fire unscathed, Chandra overthrows the Order of Heliud on the plane of Regatha .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Sarkhan Vol becomes a vassal of Nicol Bolas shortly before the reunification of the shards of Alara upon Jund .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: The Conflux - Bolas reaps the seeds of war as the fractured Shards of Alara reunite. The energy from the resulting Maelstrom is absorbed by Bolas and returns much of the power he lost in the Mending. Bolas fights Ajani Goldmane and an avatar of himself, and is driven from the plane. The rest of the unified Alara is embroiled in a worldwide war between the former shards. Heartbroken, Elspeth Tirel flees to Urborg .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Curse of the Chain Veil - Liliana Vess takes control of the Chain Veil on Shandalar. She uses its power to overthrow Kothophed , one of her demon masters. Sarkhan is sighted tracking Liliana. Garruk Wildspeaker runs afoul of Liliana on Shandalar and becomes cursed by the Chain Veil. He turns to Jace to find Liliana, interrupting his research of the Dragon Scroll that Chandra had stolen from Kephalai .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Chandra surfaces on Zendikar looking for the ruin-sage Anowon , and with him, searches for the Eye of Ugin . They encounter Sarkhan once they reach the eye, and he plans to sacrifice Chandra.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Jace appears and assists Chandra, striking an uneasy truce to defeat Sarkhan. Their actions trigger a reaction in the Hedrons surrounding the Eye.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Chandra and Sarkhan leave the plane the same day, and, after witnessing Eldrazi brood on the loose, Jace leaves 2 weeks later, intending to learn more. Sarkhan returns to Bolas's Meditation Realm to inform the dragon of the events that transpired at the Eye. Bolas reveals Tezzeret's body to Sarkhan while he rebuilds it.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Release of the Eldrazi - Nissa Revane and her Tajuru allies are attacked by Eldrazi brood lineage loosed by the events at the Eye of Ugin. Sorin Markov shows up and deals with the remaining brood, recovering Anowon after 3 months of enslavement by the Eldrazi in the process. Nissa agrees to lead him to Akoum. Upon arrival, the elf and the vampire argue with each other, which results in Nissa breaking the central hedron in the Eye of Ugin. The Eldrazi Titans are freed.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: The Battle for Zendikar begins. Gideon Jura follows Chandra to Zendikar but loses track of her around the Eye of Ugin. He stays at Fort Keff and defeats a handful of brood lineage that attack the fort. Upon seeing Emrakul on the horizon, he flees, knowing he does not stand a chance against the monstrosity. He travels to Ravnica to petition the help of an organization of planeswalkers.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Bolas finishes his efforts to restore Tezzeret's mind and body, giving him the task of finding the secret of Etherium from Crucius the Mad. Ultimately successful, Bolas then sends Tezzeret to Mirrodin, having become aware of the Phyrexian taint spreading on that plane.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Koth encounters Elspeth and Venser on Urborg. He enlists their help in dealing with the Phyrexian corruption taking place on Mirrodin.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Creation of New Phyrexia - After years of creeping corruption, Mirrodin falls to the Phyrexians and becomes New Phyrexia . However, Koth, Elspeth, Venser, and Melira succeed in curing Karn, restoring his spark and sanity at the cost of Venser's life.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: The archangel Avacyn and the demon Griselbrand , to whom Liliana owes a portion of her soul, disappear from the plane of Innistrad .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Tamiyo travels to Innistrad for the first time, studying its moon and becoming acquainted with Jenrik . She spends some months there before returning to her family on Kamigawa .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Sorin returns to his homeplane of Innistrad after the fiasco on Zendikar to find it destroying itself.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Anafenza is executed by her cousin Oret and returned by him as a kin-tree spirit .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: The Legion of Dusk depart for and arrive on the continent of Ixalan.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)
The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Gideon Jura arrives on Ravnica to find tensions increasing amid the rise of the Gateless and the resurgence of the guilds. Seeing the danger posed to citizens of Ravnica, he swears to aid Aurelia in quelling the uprising, having had little success so far in finding planeswalker allies to aid Zendikar against the Eldrazi.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Garruk pursues Liliana to Innistrad , intent on having her remove his curse or killing her for inflicting it upon him.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Siege of Thraben - Gisa and Geralf Cecani lay siege to the city of Thraben , leading to the death of the Guardian of the City, Lothar , and the Lunarch , Mikaeus Cecani .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Sundering of the Helvault - After a few months of searching, Liliana tracks Griselbrand 's disappearance to the Helvault and manipulates Thalia into destroying it.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Cursemute - after being freed from the Helvault , Avacyn cast spells to purify curses on Innistrad, creating the Wolfir and healing some of their lycanthropy entirely.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Niv-Mizzet begins extensive research into the nature of the Implicit Maze , appointing Ral Zarek as the lead researcher.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Jace finishes his research concerning the Implicit Maze . Shocked by the answers he discovered, he erases his memory, effectively losing 6 months of his life.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Elesh Norn seizes power over the red and black factions of New Phyrexia.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Koth attempts to assassinate the ascendant Elesh Norn with an incredibly powerful spellbomb, forcing Elspeth Tirel to leave New Phyrexia for Theros . Koth escapes alive into the bowels of the furnace layers. He hopes that the Mirran Resistance can one day overthrow the Phyrexians .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: (Alternate timeline) Anafenza becomes khan of the Abzan.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Narset's planeswalker spark ignites.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Davriel Cane arrives on Innistrad
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Preparations for the Inventors' Fair begin on Kaladesh
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: The Supreme Verdict — Niv-Mizzet arranges a city-wide race of the Implicit Maze with a champion from each guild. When Lazav incites the maze-runners to violence at the Forum of Azor , Jace Beleren merges their minds to stop the conflict and this triggers the maze's bailiff to make Jace the new Living Guildpact .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Silence of the Gods - on Theros , Xenagos enacts his plans to manipulate the gods into confronting each other, forcing Kruphix to enact the Silence, removing them from Theros and leaving his path open to ascend to godhood.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Great Revel - Following a battle in Akros where Rhordon is killed and Anax badly injured, Xenagos ascends, throwing off the balance of power in Theros. Daxos dies at 22 years old, and Elspeth flees into the wilderness.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Deicide in Nyx - alongside Ajani, Elspeth Tirel enters the realm of Nyx to topple the new god. They kill Xenagos and free Nylea , but Heliod kills Elspeth with her weapon.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Sarkhan Vol returns to his former present, though he was never born in this timeline.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Sorin's Restoration - Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin from his Hedron cocoon. He informs Ugin about the release of the Eldrazi , and Ugin dismisses him and demands that he seek out Nahiri .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Sarkhan seeks out Ugin and explains his role in the release of the Eldrazi and in saving Ugin's life. He leaves Ugin and meets with Narset , a planeswalker he had met in an alternate timeline.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: These events happened in an alternate timeline. Tarkir: Sarkhan returns to Tarkir. Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and finds Ugin dead. Varuk takes control of the Mardu after Zurgo 's obsession with Sarkhan becomes clear. The appearance of the Alabaster Kirin . Sarkhan, Narset — whose planeswalker spark did not ignite in this timeline — and Zurgo reach Ugin's Nexus. Zurgo Kills Narset. Nexus of Fate - Sarkhan enters the Tomb of the Spirit Dragon and travels 1280 years backward in time.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Ajani visits Tamiyo on Kamigawa.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Tamiyo returns to Innistrad from Kamigawa and begins her investigation into the plane's rapid changes.
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: After one month on Kamigawa, Ajani travels to Kaladesh
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: Emrakul is last seen on Zendikar
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: While still trying to quell unrest on Ravnica, Gideon renews his efforts to save Zendikar from the Eldrazi. Finding clues tying the plane's hedrons to both the invaders and Zendikar's leylines, he goes to recruit the biggest expert on leylines, Jace Beleren .
paragraphs.section: The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)

paragraphs.text: In the Battle for Zendikar the Zendikar resistance army led by Gideon Jura , Nissa Revane and Kiora assaults and recaptures Sea Gate from the Ulamog brood.
Weeks after Jace Beleren arrived on Zendikar, Ob Nixilis destroys the hedron network meant to capture Ulamog . He regains his planeswalker's spark and is chased away by Chandra Nalaar .
The Formation of the Gatewatch - Gideon Jura , Jace Beleren , Chandra Nalaar , and Nissa Revane swear oaths to save the planes together, forming the Gatewatch .
Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek - the Gatewatch defeats Kozilek and Ulamog . The two Eldrazi titans are incinerated and destroyed 1 to 3 Years after their release .
The Roil temporarily stops.
Jace travels from Zendikar to Innistrad.
4559, c. 6 Months before the Hour Devastation
The Travails happen on Innistrad .
Nahiri calls the third Eldrazi titan, Emrakul , forth to Innistrad to take a revenge on Sorin Markov for imprisoning her in the Helvault .
Unmaking of Avacyn - Emrakul's corruption forces Sorin to unmake Avacyn. Innistrad quickly sees the creation of many mutated horrors .
Battle of Thraben - Aided by Tamiyo and Liliana Vess , the Gatewatch fights Emrakul. Emrakul is sealed in Innistrad's moon . Liliana formally joins the Gatewatch.
4560, c. 3 Months before the Hour of Devastation

Inventors' Fair - Liliana investigates the presence of Tezzeret on Kaladesh . Chandra reunites with her mother, Pia Nalaar , with both of them having thought the other had been killed years ago. The Gatewatch starts to aids the Renegades in their rebellion against the Consulate .
Vraska becomes employed by Nicol Bolas and planeswalks to Ixalan .
4560, c. 1 Month before the Hour of Devastation

The Aether Revolt - Tezzeret steals the core of the Planar Bridge for his master Nicol Bolas and flees Kaladesh. Dovin Baan and Kambal are deposed. About seven months after he left Kamigawa, Ajani Goldmane joins the Gatewatch.
The Hour of Devastation
On Amonkhet , the Gatewatch discovers that Bolas is creating an army of Eternals , highly trained fighting specialists who had been zombified while keeping their skills intact.

The Final Hours occur two days after the arrival of the Gatewatch. Liliana Vess kills the demon Razaketh . Oketra , Kefnet , Bontu , Rhonas , and The Scorpion God are killed, and Naktamun falls. Samut ascends. When the Gatewatch confronts Nicol Bolas , they are soundly defeated.
Seriously wounded, Jace flees to Ixalan , where he is trapped by the power of the Immortal Sun .
Chandra, Gideon, Liliana, and Nissa flee to Dominaria, utterly defeated, and argue. Nissa leaves the Gatewatch and planeswalks to Zendikar.
Jhoira recovers the Skyship Weatherlight and forms a new Weatherlight crew .
4560, c. 40 Days after the Hour of Devastation
Jace is found by Vraska and joins the crew of the Belligerent .
4560, c. 2 Months after the Hour of Devastation
Jhoira finishes gathering her crew.
Ajani planeswalks to Dominaria.
4560, c. 3-4 Months after the Hour of Devastation
Rediscovery of Orazca - Jace defeats Azor and becomes romantically involved with Vraska . Tezzeret steals the Immortal Sun from Orazca . The Sun Empire reclaims the city as its capital.
Vraska planeswalks to Ravnica and takes control of the Golgari Swarm .
Jace planeswalks to Dominaria.
On Dominaria , the Gatewatch joins with the planeswalkers Jaya Ballard and Karn to fight Belzenlok 's Cabal . Teferi regains his planeswalker's spark and formally joins the Gatewatch.
Huatli planeswalks to Kaladesh and spends a few days there with Saheeli
Huatli planeswalks to Ravnica and begins studying the government there
c. 4-5 Months after the Hour of Devastation
The Gatewatch and the crew of the Weatherlight defeat Belzenlok with the help of the Blackblade . Nicol Bolas takes control of Liliana Vess.
On Ravnica, tensions between the guilds rise, as Nicol Bolas has been warping them to his needs. They also fight internally between the forces pulling them toward or away from Bolas's influence.
4560, c. 5 Months after the Hour of Devastation
Saheeli is working on a project on Dominaria
Huatli becomes romantically involved with Saheeli
Tacenda Verlasen and Davriel Cane defeat Willia Verlasen . Tacenda absorbs the Bog Entity , and ascends .
4560 AR (10,077 ZC), c. 4-5 Months after the Hour of Devastation

The War of the Spark takes place on Ravnica the day after the Gatewatch battle Belzenlok. Teyo ascends on Gobakhan and is pulled to Ravnica as his first planeswalk. Liliana is commanded by Bolas to send the Dreadhorde against the plane's defenders. The Elderspell - a spell cast by Bolas allows the Eternals to harvest planeswalker sparks by mere touch. Dack and Domri die and their sparks are harvested. Niv-Mizzet is resurrected and becomes the new Living Guildpact . Gideon Jura sacrifices himself for Liliana while she turns against Nicol Bolas . Bontu harvests all of Bolas's acquired sparks as well as his native ones, and is disintegrated. Nicol Bolas is defeated and thought dead by all but Jace Beleren , while Ugin in reality imprisons him on the Meditation Plane . Nissa rejoins the Gatewatch, and Kaya formally joins as well.
Dovin Baan is killed by Atkos Tarr .
Jace Beleren planeswalks to Vryn
Still cursed by the Chain Veil , Garruk Wildspeaker travels to Eldraine . He attacks Oko , but is subdued and falls under the fey's charm spell.
Oko turns King Kenrith into a stag during the local Harvest Season.

Restoration of the High King - during the local Winter Solstice, Will Kenrith and Rowan Kenrith go on a quest to find their father. Oko 's plot to start a war between the Wilds and Kingdoms of Eldraine is revealed. Garruk Wildspeaker is freed from the veil curse by the Cauldron of Eternity . Rowan and Will Kenrith 's shared spark ignites. Garruk Wildspeaker planeswalks after them, promising their parents he will watch over them.
c. 4560 AR (Beam Year 2,985)
Sami 's cat Mirri weftwalks from the Seriema.
Between 4560 and 4561
Chandra Nalaar goes on a campaign of heroism and learns to accept Gideon's death.
Tibalt kidnaps Pia Nalaar , but she is rescued by Chandra and Ajani Goldmane .
Garruk Wildspeaker briefly stays with Will and Rowan . After a few weeks, he leaves them, satisfied they are safe.

The War of the Gods takes place on Theros . Ashiok learns about the Phyrexians from Elspeth's nightmares. Daxos 's soul is restored to his Returned body. Elspeth Tirel defeats Heliod and escapes the Underworld . Heliod is imprisoned by Erebos within the Underworld, carrying a giant boulder. Klothys creates Calix to pursue her, and his spark ignites so that he can follow Elspeth to other planes.

Battle at the Ozolith - in a bloody battle between Lukka and his bonders and Jirina Kudro and her monster hunters, Lukka receives the power of the Ozolith from an unidentified planeswalker, and creates a monster army, destroying his opposition and betraying his allies.

Siege of Drannith - Lukka's attempt at besieging Drannith on Ikoria is halted by the city's defenses and his overuse of the Ozolith. General Kudro is killed, and Lukka's spark ignites. The unidentified planeswalker's influence is lifted from the Ozolith.

Rise of the Skyclaves - An adventuring party led by Kesenya infiltrates the Emeria Skyclave over Tazeem , left abandoned by Iona following the Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek . In their exploration of the skyclave, they activate its magical defenses, causing the plane's six other skyclaves to rise into the sky once more.
An adventuring party led by Anowon kills Grakmaw .
Nahiri and Nissa Revane recover the Lithoform Key from the Akoum Skyclave .
Autumn ( Ravnica ) — Nissa enlists Jace Beleren 's help in stopping Nahiri from using the Lithoform Core .
Nahiri, along with Akiri , Zareth San , Kaza , and Orah recover the Lithoform Core from the Murasa Skyclave. Zareth is killed when Nahiri activates the Core.
Healing of Zendikar - after a fight in the Singing City , Nissa takes the Core from Nahiri, activating it and revitalizing the plane. Jace recovers the inert Core.
Vorinclex infects Tibalt with glistening oil , coercing him to cause chaos on Kaldheim .
Tibalt imprisons and impersonates Valki , kills Koll , and steals the Sword of the Realms .

Battle for Kaldheim - Kaya Cassir tracks Vorinclex to Kaldheim, but fails to kill the praetor before he can escape with a Tyrite sample. Tibalt opens a Doomskar between Immersturm and Bretagard . Koma is released, Kaya kills Varragoth , and Halvar seals the Omenpaths and ends the Doomskar.
Tournaments are held in Valor's Reach on Kylem . Will and Rowan Kenrith take part.
Summer ( Arcavios ) — Liliana Vess takes a role as Professor at Strixhaven under the pseudonym Serafina Onyx.
Fall semester ( Arcavios ) — Will and Rowan Kenrith depart Kylem to join Strixhaven University at the invitation of Kasmina .
Winter ( Arcavios ) — Quintorius Kand and Asterion rediscover the lost Loxodon city of Zantafar.

Winter — Oriq Attack on Strixhaven - agents of the Oriq , including Lukka , attack the University, killing several students. Extus Narr summons the Blood Avatar but is stopped by Will , Rowan and Liliana , dying in the fight. The University is rebuilt, with a new monument to the lost, and Liliana stays on as a Professor, now using her real name.
Harvest Moon ( Innistrad ) — The day-night cycle of Innistrad shifts close to Eternal Night .
Harvest Moon— Saryth is killed in a fight with Katilda and Leinore , preventing her from summoning the Coiled One .
Harvest Moon — Wrenn returns Six to Kessig and bonds with Seven .
Harvest Moon — Liesa is reborn when the demon known as the Buried Lord is summoned, though she kills him again.
Harvest Moon — Arlinn Kord and Teferi Akosa ask Sorin Markov for help slowing the sunset. When he refuses, the angel Sigarda attacks him, while the two planeswalkers retrieve the Moonsilver Key .

Harvest Moon — Arinos of Lambholt summons Old Stickfingers and is then killed or possessed by him. After killing at least two other people, the creature was contained by Ariosa , Rem Karolus , and Vadrok .
Harvest Moon — Ludevic of Ulm creates Olag .
Harvesttide festival — Olivia Voldaren crashes the festival, stealing the Moonsilver Key and killing Katilda before she can perform the ritual to restore the cycle of day and night.
The Eternal Night begins - Voldaren captures Sigarda and steals Edgar Markov 's body from his tomb, intending to wed him and join the plane's two most powerful vampire families.
Odric is sired into a vampire by Henrika Domnathi .
Torens frees Eruth and Umbris . The villagers of Traublassen kill Vytas and Boris .
Runo Stromkirk summons Krothuss .
Katilda 's spirit, contained within the Moonsilver Key , frees Sigarda .
Kaya Cassir , Chandra Nalaar , Teferi Akosa and Arlinn Kord crash Olivia Voldaren 's wedding and retrieve the Moonsilver Key.
The Eternal Night ends - Katilda's spirit is restored to her body, and the regular day-night cycle of Innistrad is restored.
The orochi samurai Chishiro re-bonds with the kami Kaima and kills Keimi , the giant frog mount of the human ninja Tatsunari .
Jin-Gitaxias kills Tameshi .
Tamiyo aids Kaito Shizuki 's search for Tezzeret and the Wanderer .
Kaito Shizuki , Tamiyo , and The Wanderer fight Tezzeret , Jin-Gitaxias and the Asari . Light-Paws is appointed regent of Kamigawa and Risona is captured.

Creation of the first Phyrexianized planeswalker - Tezzeret flees with the Reality Chip and the bodies of Tamiyo and Jin-Gitaxias . Tamiyo is compleated by Jin-Gitaxias , becoming the first Phyrexian planeswalker .
Ajani Goldmane sends Elspeth Tirel to New Capenna to search for an answer to the New Phyrexian threat.
Errant and Parnesse marry. Errant's father Anhelo murders Fiero Vespin and Severo Jr.
Elspeth Tirel , Vivien Reid , Tezzeret , and Urabrask work to find the source of Halo , a potential tool to defeat the New Phyrexians.
New Year's Eve — Adversary War - Ob Nixilis begins the Adversary War by attacking the leadership of the plane, uprooting the family order and killing the Maestros boss Xander .
New Year's Day — Giada sacrifices herself, reawakening the New Capennan angels held in stasis across the city and ending the Adversary War .
4562, 2 Years after the Hour of Devastation
Tezzeret transports Sheoldred from New Phyrexia to Dominaria using the Planar Bridge .

The second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria begins. A few months later, a peace summit between New Benalia and Keld at Oyster Bay is interrupted by Phyrexian sleeper agents . Aron Capashen , leader of New Benalia, is compleated by a resurrected Ertai . Phyrexians overrun Argivia , the capital of New Argive . Ajani is compleated , joining the Phyrexian side under Elesh Norn 's direct influence. The Skyship Weatherlight is compleated . Ajani throws Jaya off the Mana Rig to her death. Karn is captured by Phyrexians. Though he is immune to Phyrexian compleation , they destroy his Sylex and disassemble his body into its components. The Mana Rig is destroyed.
Saheeli Rai creates a replica Sylex .

Teferi's Temporal Projection - Teferi 's spirit is sent back through time to the Brothers' War with the help of Saheeli and Kaya . They discover the secrets of how to operate the sylex to destroy the Phyrexians, but Teferi's spirit gets caught in a time fracture and is left stranded in the phased-out Zhalfir .

Teferi discovers that only 10 years have passed in Zhalfir since it was phased out in the first Phyrexian invasion. Three weeks after Teferi's arrival, Kaervek escapes from his amber prison, wounding Mageta in the process.
Tibalt is compleated and joins the Phyrexians.
Ixhel kills Geth , forming Vishgraz from his remains.
A ten-planeswalker Gatewatch strike team infiltrates New Phyrexia , but are foiled by Elesh Norn .
As a result, Vraska , Nahiri , Lukka , Jace and Nissa are all compleated . Kaito Shizuki , Kaya Cassir , and Tyvar Kell are briefly captured.
Koth and a disassembled but still alive Karn are discovered by the planeswalkers and rejoin their ranks.
Tyvar Kell fights and kills a compleated Tibalt .
Jace activates the Sylex, but to save the worlds of the multiverse, Elspeth grabs it before it can trigger fully and planeswalks it into the Blind Eternities .

Start of the New Phyrexian Invasion Elesh Norn orders Ajani to execute Sheoldred . She then sends her top-ranked minions to assault various planes - Vraska to Ravnica , Nahiri to Zendikar , Lukka to Ikoria , Tamiyo to Kamigawa , Ajani to Theros , Jace to Vryn , and Atraxa to New Capenna . She keeps Nissa with her on New Phyrexia . The planes of Aranzhur , Cabralin , Ilcae , Mirrankkar , and Obsidias are quickly overcome. Tezzeret receives a new darksteel metal body as a reward by Elesh Norn for the capture of the traitor Rona , finally separating him from the Planar Bridge . Tezzeret escapes before Jin-Gitaxias can compleat him and seeks refuge from the war in the former headquarters of the Infinite Consortium . Kaya , Kaito and Tyvar return to Dominaria and share the news of their defeat with Vivien , Liliana , Chandra and Wrenn . Chandra and Wrenn planeswalk to New Phyrexia and join the rebels there in the fight against Elesh Norn , while Kaya and Kaito go to Kamigawa . Tyvar travels to Kaldheim and Vivien to Ikoria , while Liliana travels to Arcavios . On Kamigawa , Tamiyo compleats Boseiju before betraying Elesh Norn by letting herself be killed by the Wanderer . This triggers a spell Tamiyo had prepared earlier, forming Tamiyo's memory into a spiritual personification free of Phyrexian influence. Hidetsugu is freed from the spirit realm. After the invasion tree opens Doomskars across Kaldheim , its defenders join together and burn their World Tree , denying the invaders its power. Invocation of the Founders - on Arcavios , most of the professors are compleated , including Nassari and Shaile Talonrook , but not Embrose Lu or Liliana Vess . Quintorius Kand , Rootha Squallheart , Dina , Zimone Wola , and Killian Lu cast the invocation to protect against the invasion, and Quint's planeswalker's spark ignites. On Ikoria , a compleated and monstrous Lukka destroys the largest Human city, Drannith . Vivien leads Jirina Kudro and refugees from the city into Vadrok 's lair to lure Lukka there. Vadrok kills Lukka and spares Vivien and the refugees. On Ixalan , Huatli leads the defense of the plane. She leads the soldiers of the Sun Empire with reluctant help from Mavren Fein and his host of vampires. At Orazca , she summons the Elder Dinosaurs to drive the intruders back. A compleated Etali attacks the city but is killed by Zacama . On Eldraine , the leaders of the courts are defeated by the Phyrexians . Algenus and Linden Kenrith are both killed, and Ayara is compleated. A powerful spell cast by Rankle lures the invaders into a chasm, and Ayara falls to her death. Wicked Slumber - The fae lord Talion casts a large-scale sleep spell with the help of the witch sisters Agatha , Eriette , and Hylda , making the invading Phyreians comatose. On Dominaria , Tolaria West is decimated by Phyrexians, but the invaders are rebuffed by the New Coalition . Elesh Norn orders Urabrask 's execution, but appears to stop short of killing him outright. In the wake of the Sylex blast, Elspeth is met with an apparition of Serra . Infused with white mana, Elspeth returns to New Phyrexia as an archangel. She saves Karn from destruction at the hands of Jin-Gitaxias , and stabs Elesh Norn with her sword, allowing Chandra and Wrenn to approach the invasion tree, Realmbreaker . New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch - Wrenn bonds with Realmbreaker and uses its interplanar portals to reach Zhalfir and Teferi . She expends her energy and life-force to switch Zhalfir's phased-out pocket plane with New Phyrexia, bringing the Zhalfirins into the war. On Ravnica , Vraska leads the invasion, compleating most of the Golgari Swarm and many in the Simic Combine and Izzet League , while enacting revenge on the Azorius Senate . Some part of her remains incompleat due to a partition created by Jace . She battles Ral Zarek , who uses a sonic device to neutralize the glistening oil and disable Vraska's body. She falls into a pile of rubble and disappears. On Zendikar , Nahiri battles Tazri , Akiri , Linvala , Kaza and Orah . She fuses with the Emeria skyclave , which is brought to the ground. On Capenna , Atraxa leads the compleation of Anhelo and most of the Maestros . Errant and Parnesse escape and lead a team to bring Park Heights down on top of Atraxa, killing her. Capenna's angels use the omenpaths opened by Wrenn and Realmbreaker to enter other planes, spreading Halo across the Multiverse and aiding each plane's defenders. On Theros , Ajani compleats enough faithful to compleat the majority of the plane's pantheon of Gods , including Heliod , Erebos , and possibly the other three Major Gods. Heliod is killed by Kaya Cassir . On New Phyrexia , Vorinclex is killed. Jin-Gitaxias is also killed when a Zhalfirin woman smashes his war machine and lets him be eaten by his creations. Karn reassembles his broken body, and unmakes the defeated Elesh Norn . With her death, all Phyrexians and the glistening oil become inert, effectively ending the invasion.
Following the New Phyrexian Invasion and the use of Realmbreaker , Omenpaths open across all the planes, allowing non-planeswalkers to cross the boundaries between them.

On Ravnica, Niv-Mizzet initiates his "Omenpath Project" after recognizing the planar portals and their patterns. He dispatches agents to begin researching and mapping the Omenpaths to bring them under his control.
Teferi plants an acorn of Wrenn in the soil of Zhalfir .
Karn gives up his spark and Melira sacrifices her life to restore Ajani and Nissa , removing their compleation and bringing them back to life.

The Desparkening : The aftereffects of the Sylex Blast in the Blind Eternities cause the vast majority of planeswalkers to lose their sparks. Among them are Aminatou , Calix , Daretti , Huatli , Kiora , Koth , Narset , Niko Aris , Nissa Revane , Ob Nixilis , Saheeli Rai , Sarkhan Vol , Teferi Akosa , Tyvar Kell , Vraska , and Rowan and Will Kenrith .

Ajani Goldmane , Ashiok , Chandra Nalaar , Elspeth Tirel , Jace Beleren , Kaito Shizuki , Kaya Cassir , Oko , Quintorius Kand , Ral Zarek , Tezzeret , and Ugin are unaffected by the spark rupture and retain their sparks.
Nahiri , healed of her compleation , finds her spark to have been removed from her body, and accidentally destroys it .
Saheeli Rai uses these Omenpaths to reunite with Huatli on Ixalan .
Kaervek escapes from Zhalfir via Omenpath.
Quintorius begins exploring archaeological sites across the Multiverse and finds evidence of a lost multiplanar empire .
The Wicked Slumber begins spreading across Eldraine . Will Kenrith declares himself High King.
Indrelon is stolen from castle Vantress .
On Ravnica, the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations rises to prominence during rebuilding efforts.
Troyan enters an Omenpath from Ravnica to Eldraine .
Omenpaths allow travel to Thunder Junction , and the first towns and settlements begin appearing across the plane.

Indigo Revolution - the Consulate on Kaladesh is overthrown in a mostly bloodless coup by the New Culture Collective and allied factions. It is replaced by the Avishkar Assembly , which renames the plane to "Avishkar."
The gods Ketramose and Sab-Sunen are born on Amonkhet.
The dual aspects of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor begin to fluctuate across the plane as the gods Eirdu and Isilu return.

Stormnexus Ritual - on Tarkir , rebellions against each of the dragonlords rise, bearing the names of the ancient clans. The conflict escalates into war, which is decided in favor of the clans when Narset and the other khans perform a spell to make the Dragonlords disappear, and the clans rise to power.
Tarkir's dragonstorms begin to spontaneously appear on other planes.

Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse , a plot to rebirth the Multiverse, begins after Jace and Vraska spend months convalescing on Vryn after a combination of his psychic defenses and his mother Ranna 's healing prowess keeps them from succumbing to phyresis.
c. 4563, 6 months after the New Phyrexian Invasion
The half-fae Kellan kills the witch Agatha .

Will Kenrith and Kellan capture Eriette , ending the Wicked Slumber and forcing Ashiok to planeswalk away from Eldraine. Rowan escapes. Jace Beleren , disguised as Ashiok, later frees and recruits Eriette.
Kellan enters an Omenpath from Eldraine to Ixalan .
c. 4563, at least one year after the New Phyrexian Invasion
The first annual interplanar Ghirapur Grand Prix .
4563 (5 Dawn Era ), 14-17 months after the New Phyrexian Invasion
The Brazen Coalition mining town Downtown, including mayor Xavier Sal , is entirely taken over by the Mycotyrant .

Reopening of Ixalan's Core - Huatli , Quintorius Kand , and twenty-two Sun Empire warriors including Inti , Caparocti Sunborn , and Wayta explore under Orazca . They eventually reach the River Heralds city of Matzalantli and enter Ixalan's Core , meeting the Oltec .

Thirty members of the Legion of Dusk 's Queen's Bay Company , including Vito Quijano de Pasamonte , Bartolomé del Presidio , Amalia Benavides Aguirre , and Clavileño enter Ixalan's Core in search of the bat god Aclazotz . After meeting with Kellan and being captured by the Malamet and the Oltec , Vito kills Bartolomé in an escape and he and Clavileño find and free Aclazotz.
Nine Brazen Coalition pirates , including Malcolm Lee and Breeches , investigate the disappearances in Downtown. They find the Mycotyrant and flee to the Core.
All of these factions clash in a battle in the Core. Aclazotz nearly cages Chimil , the Inner Sun. Inti, Vito, Clavileño, and the Mycotyrant's host body are killed.
Kellan and Amalia enter an Omenpath and travel to Ravnica .
Quint discovers a Coin Empire ship in the Core.
The Mycotyrant escapes to a new body on the surface and takes over Sunray Bay, boarding a ship and sailing for High and Dry.
Aclazotz escapes to the surface, boarding a ship and sailing for Vona de Iedo in Torrezon.
Saheeli, Caztaca Huicintli , Elenda of Garrano , and Beckett Brass hold a peace meeting, agreeing to support each other's factions in their governments.
Malcolm and Breeches reach the surface and report the existence of the Mycotyrant. They run into Vraska, who hires them for a job taking place on Thunder Junction.
c. 4564 (c. 10,080 ZC), ~17 months after the New Phyrexian Invasion
Anzrag , a Gruul god, breaks loose of guild control and wreaks havoc across the Ninth District. It is stopped by the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations .

The Murders - Spring — One month later, during a party at Karlov Manor, a rising Ravnican crime wave comes to the forefront with the assassination of Zegana . Etrata is arrested on suspicion of committing the crime.
Spring — Three days later, Teysa Karlov is assassinated. Kaya Cassir takes the lead on the investigation. Alquist Proft breaks Etrata out of Azorius's custody, believing her innocence.
Spring — Massacre Girl is hired to assassinate Proft for interfering in guild business, but is stopped by Etrata.

Spring — Krenko kidnaps Kylox in search of information on the murders. When an assassin arrives to kill Krenko, Kylox is accidentally killed in the scuffle. Massacre Girl attempts to murder Aurelia but is stopped by the guild leader, who gives investigators twenty-four hours to solve the case before the Boros Legion declares war on the Cult of Rakdos .
Spring — In the ensuing twenty-four hours, Anzrag escapes Agency custody and rampages through their headquarters. Agrus Kos is captured by Judith .

Spring — The following day, Proft calls the leaders of the guilds to Vitu-Ghazi to reveal the killer. He explains that Trostani — specifically Oba — was responsible for organizing the murders in retribution for those she considered traitors to the plane during the Phyrexian Invasion.

Spring — Oba attacks the gathered assembly, and in the chaos, Tolsimir Wolfblood is killed by Yarus . Judith flees, but is attacked by Massacre Girl and is not heard from again. Kaya Cassir and Etrata capture Oba , and her sisters render her unconscious.
Spring — Trostani withdraws as leader of the Selesnya Conclave , leaving Emmara Tandris to lead in her absence.
Spring — Teysa Karlov 's ghost returns, continuing her leadership of the Orzhov Syndicate , forming a new ghost council .
Spring — Proft discovers Niv-Mizzet 's Omenpath Project and offers his services to the dragon.
c. 4564, ~18 months after the New Phyrexian Invasion
Ral Zarek , at the behest of Niv-Mizzet , sets up communication relays across Thunder Junction and other planes via the Omenpaths .

The Vault Heist - Oko 's gang of criminals, Akul and his Hellspurs, and Ral Zarek , with Kellan in tow, all reach the vault of Maag Taranau at the same time. After a three-way battle, Jace Beleren and Vraska seize Loot , the Fomori child that was locked in the vault, and disappear. The vault launches into the sky, with Akul trapped inside.
Amalia travels to Thunder Junction to reunite with Kellan and begin mapping the plane.
Jace and Vraska travel to the plane of Bloomburrow .
Sometime after this, Nashi returns to Kamigawa before traveling to the plane of Duskmourn .
c. 4564, almost two years after the New Phyrexian Invasion
Theft of Maha's Egg - Late Spring — On Bloomburrow , King Glarb hires Cruelclaw to steal Maha 's egg. After years of peace, the Calamity Beasts begin attacking Valley again.
Late Spring — Ral Zarek follows Jace Beleren 's aether trail to Bloomburrow.
Late Spring — Mabel , Helga and their team of adventurers meet up with Ral and discover that a rogue dragonstorm has given birth to the Dragonhawk , a new threat to Valley.
Late Spring — Mabel reclaims Maha 's egg and returns it to its mother, thus ending the threat of the Calamity Beasts to Valley.
Late Spring — Having learned that Jace and Vraska left Bloomburrow together, Ral follows their trail off-plane.
c. 4564, at least 21 months after the New Phyrexian Invasion

Duskmourn Rescue Mission - Kaito Shizuki , Niko Aris , Tyvar Kell , The Wanderer and Zimone Wola travel to Duskmourn in search of Nashi . Alquist Proft , Aminatou , Etrata , Niv-Mizzet , and Yoshimaru monitor them from Ravnica .
Loot wanders into one of Duskmourn's doors. Jace and Vraska travel to the House in an attempt to retrieve him but fail, and he is captured by Valgavoth .

City joins the Cult of Valgavoth , who attack the carnival grounds and attic encampment safe zones, capturing Rill , Sunset , and a few other survivors and killing the rest. Dawn escapes and joins the Benefactors .
On Ravnica, Niv-Mizzet completes his mapping project and secures the plane's Omenpaths .
c. 4564, at least two years after the New Phyrexian Invasion
The second annual interplanar Ghirapur Grand Prix takes place across Avishkar , Amonkhet , and Muraganda . The Champions of Amonkhet win and claim the Aetherspark as their prize.
Jace incites a coup headed by Mohar Varma in order to disrupt the race and gets Loot back from Winter in the confusion. The coup fails, and Varma is sent to prison.
4564, five years after Sorin's Restoration
Spring semester (Arcavios) — Invited by Professor Kasmina , the first interplanetary class of students arrive at Strixhaven .
Meditation Plane Breach - Elspeth Tirel travels to Tarkir and meets with Narset to investigate the multiversal dragonstorm outbreak. Their search leads them to an Omenpath to the Meditation Realm .
Sarkhan Vol and Taigam perform a corrupted ritual and gain control of the plane's wild dragons, which Sarkhan uses to wreak havoc.
In the Meditation Realm, Elspeth and Narset find Jace, Loot, Ugin , and Nicol Bolas . Elspeth accidentally tells Bolas his name.
Jace steals the Spirit-Gem and tries to exploit the Meditation Realm's power to reach back in time and undo the Phyrexian Invasion . He fails and seemingly dies. All others in the Realm leave.
Ugin returns to Tarkir, defeats Sarkhan, and puts a stop to the dragonstorm outbreak.
Nicol Bolas escapes into the Multiverse.

Jace reforms as the custodian of the Meditation Realm, with his mind fractured into various aspects. These aspects set about the creation of the Echoverse , envisioned as a world without suffering, using themselves as a conduit.
Jace uses part of his soul to create Tamira .
Jace begins to pare parts of himself away that don't believe in his plan and exile them into his mental space. Eventually, the Theorist stands ascendant over them all.
c. 4564 (Beam Year 2,989)
Mission for the Endstone - Tezzeret hires Sami and Tannuk to recover the Endstone from Sigma's Reach .
Oko returns to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor for the first time in his life, finding Maralen on the throne of Glen Elendra . He mistakes her for a reborn Oona and begins to plot her downfall.

Spring semester (Arcavios) — Oko lures four Strixhaven students, Abigale , Kirol , Sanar , and Tamira , through an Omenpath onto Lorwyn. They accidentally awaken Isilu, who causes chaos across the plane.
Spring semester (Arcavios) — Liliana Vess is visited by Ajani Goldmane , who tells her about the events on Tarkir. She is informed about the missing students and sends Ajani to retrieve them.

Spring semester (Arcavios) — While searching for Maralen, Kirol is kidnapped by Lluwen , who brings them to Morcant . Morcant plans to take the opportunity to destroy Isilu. Ajani rescues Kirol, and Lluwen decides to follow.
Spring semester (Arcavios) — The students restore balance by reuniting Isilu with Eirdu. They return to Strixhaven along with Lluwen, who enrolls there. Oko reunites with Maralen as family.
Spring semester (Arcavios) — Liliana is kidnapped by her Echoverse counterpart and taken to Hexhaven , where she is forced to provide her magical knowledge.
Chandra Nalaar arrives on Arcavios and joins the Shattered, a group of former Oriq .
An alternate version of Ral Zarek is invited as a guest lecturer at Strixhaven. He begins to seek out literature on the plane's origins.
The Archaics experience a behavior change, conducting strange rituals and becoming hostile toward people.
Fall semester (Arcavios) — Jadzi is kidnapped by the Dawning Archaic and taken to a snarl underneath Titan's Grave .

Fall semester (Arcavios) — While attempting to soothe the Archaic with a spell, Tam hurls both herself and Jadzi into the snarl, causing both to disappear and reappear in an alternate Strixhaven. Tam's friends complete the spell.

Tam brings Jadzi back to Hexhaven on the Echoverse 's version of Arcavios , moving the Theorist 's plan into its final stage. Liliana informs Tam that overwriting the Multiverse with the Echoverse as the Theorist intends would result in the former's destruction. Displeased with her doubt of the plan, the Theorist sends Tam to collect data on Innistrad . There, she makes contact with Emrakul , but fearfully breaks off the connection when Emrakul expresses interest in consuming the Echoverse. Chandra and Ajani find Vraska on Vryn and inform her that Jace is alive. They recruit Garruk on Muraganda and venture into the Echoverse. Trying to reason with Jace, the four are defeated multiple times, and eventually imprisoned in mental space by their Echoverse counterparts. In Jace's mental prison, Vraska finds an aspect of him called the Detective. The two plan to collect his other aspects and use them to defeat the Theorist. Tam realizes the Theorist is beyond reason and decides to betray him. She frees Liliana , who kills her Echoverse counterpart and goes to confront Jace. Tam leaves for the original Arcavios to warn her friends. When Jadzi realizes that the Theorist doesn't have the courage to kill her, she kills herself while he's reading her mind, forcibly exposing him to the knowledge of creation. He begins to use it to overwrite the Multiverse. While the Theorist is distracted by his focus on the overwriting, Liliana engages him in a fight. This provides an opening for Vraska to stab him in the back and for Jace's other aspects to overtake his mind, sending the Theorist into its darkest depths. Jace is reunited. Understanding his mistakes, he offers those present some final messages before peacefully accepting his death, which destabilizes the Echoverse. Jace's spark leaves his body and flies to Tam on Arcavios, making her a planeswalker. She uses her newfound telepathic mastery to contact Emrakul again. Emrakul leaves Innistrad's moon and arrives at the metaphysical border between the Multiverses, devouring the Echoverse before it can collide with the Multiverse. Chandra, Ajani, Garruk, Liliana, and Vraska flee the dematerializing Echoverse with Jace's body in tow. Vraska and Ranna Beleren hold a small funeral for Jace on Vryn. Tam arrives at the Beleren household afterward, looking for Vraska.

Since some parts of the timeline are open to interpretation, this section was created to show which of them could be different and why the current version was chosen. This section will not include an argumentation for all dates and the placing of undated events because dates are often just given in the books, and most undated events have to have happened between certain dated events because of the characters or nations present.

The Argivian Reckoning explicitly uses a year zero corresponding to the year of Urza's and Mishra's births. Other dating systems, especially the Ravnican timeline, have been implied to use year zeroes as well, with years commensurate across planes.

The book " The Thran " gives dates of all events in the "The Time of the Thran" part of this timeline relating to the Thran-Phyrexian War (9 years prior, 2 years prior, etc.). The date for the war itself is given in Apocalypse , where Yawgmoth says the war ended 9000 years ago. For this timeline, the Thran-Phyrexian War has been estimated to have happened 5000 years before the Brothers' War. Consequently, all the events narrated in the books are here reported following the same description provided in "The Thran", and under the summary indication of happening around -5000 AR. So all dates in the "The Time of the Thran" section are correct in relating to each other, but they could be some years off relating to the other dates on the timeline. Note that in Invasion , Tsabo Tavoc said the Thran-Phyrexian War ended 6000 years ago. Since Yawgmoth was there, his statements have been taken over by those of Tsabo.
The Art of Magic: the Gathering - Dominaria places the 'Time of the Thran' at 'up to around -5,000 AR', ending with the Thran-Phyrexia War, placing this date officially at about -5000 AR.

The dates of the events of the Arabian Nights comic and the life of Taysir are roughly estimated, based on The Story of the Battlemage Ravidel , which places the birth of Taysir soon after the end of the Brothers' War . Refraction of Rabiah happened still in his infancy. He left the plane as an adult about three decades later (although it's only an impression of his age derived from the art in the comic). Some sources place the Antiquities War comic after Arabian Nights. Still, one of them also reminds us that the Antiquities War comic is a narrative made by Taysir after he was trapped in the Shard and researched the mysteries of this ancient conflict.

Although it is not given a specific date, the 2014 Duels of the Planeswalkers takes place just before Rise of the Eldrazi , placing it in roughly 4557. It contains bios on each of its planeswalker characters, listing their ages as Garruk Wildspeaker, 36; Liliana Vess, "over 200"; Jace Beleren, 23; Ajani Goldmane, "appears" 30; Chandra Nalaar, 20; Nicol Bolas, "over 20,000"; Dack Fayden, 30; Elspeth Tirel, 24 (sparked at 13, squire at 17, knight at 20); and Nissa Revane, "appears" 28.

For this timeline to work, Elspeth must have been born in 4532, Chandra must have been born at an earlier time of year in 4537, and Daxos must have been born at a later date that same year. In 4545, Elspeth sparks at age 13 and meets Daxos on Theros before he turns 8. She becomes a squire on Bant in c. 4549 and is knighted in c. 4552. In 4557, Duels of the Planeswalkers occur after Chandra has turned 20 but before Elspeth has turned 25. Theros happens in 4559, after Daxos has turned 22, while Elspeth is 27.

The WotC Timeline places it between 3800 and 4130. The timeline in the Homelands comic gives no dates in the AR calendar but gives a chronology of events that takes 600 years, far longer than the 330 years in the WotC timeline. Placing 3800 as the 'Present Day' of the Homelands timeline is the only interpretation of the official timeline that works with what we know of The Kami War. Because this event has to happen at least 1,000 years before 4306 AR (according to Bolas in Future Sight), the only reasonable assumption is that the 'current' date for the Homelands timeline is 3800, not 4196. Serra's death has been placed at 3780 AR, confirming this interpretation of the timeline.

In Time Spiral , Nicol Bolas states: "The schism became a source of misery before Karona’s War by a millennium or more. When poor, mad little Ravi rang her terrible bell and the Garden ceased to exist, the echoes of that destructive chime reached far and wide, all the way to the Talon Gates and the rift they attend. The tolling of Ravi’s chime opened the rift wider and deeper, extending it across the cosmos to another realm." This line establishes The Apocalypse Chime as happening AT LEAST a millennium before Karona's War (3306 AR). It also had to happen after Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime, placing it where it ended up. Magic: The Gathering - The Visual Guide gives the year of the war's end as 3227 AR.

The storyline of Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty takes place five years after Tezzeret burned Nashi's village, was mind-wiped, and was picked up by Nicol Bolas, placing it around 4561. Ten years earlier, he caused the Emperor 's spark to ignite. Twelve months after that, Kaito Shizuki 's spark ignited when he was 15 years old. The Wanderer was about the same age as him. The set also takes place 1,200 years after the original block, placing the end of the Kami War between c. 3261-c. 3361.

Many events from early stories have been given in this reckoning, but they are often just plain wrong in later continuity. The Fallen Empires comic says it takes place over a millennium before the Ice Age, while later sources put it only 280 years before the ice. Another big event, the Planeswalker War on Corondor, is said to have happened more than a millennium after the gathering of the sages, but this would put it after the Phyrexian invasion, and since several planeswalkers that died during the invasion are major players in the 'walkers war, this can be considered an obsolete date.

paragraphs.text: Most events have been given a date in later sources by WotC because they are tied to a set and thus on their official timeline (such as Fallen Empires and Homelands). The Shadow Mage , Wayfarer and the Planeswalker War had for a long time not been given an official date, but because we know how much time happens between them, we can deduce their dates: the War happens 70 years after Sandruu's banishment and Wayfarer in the same year as the war. The chapters of Shadow Mage each give the age of Jared Carthalion at that time, and since his age is given as 16 in Wayfarer, the placement of those chapters can be deduced as well. The Planeswalker War has now officially been given a date of 4196.

paragraphs.text: The events of Mirrodin were a continuity problem. The flavor text of several cards in Mirrodin block mention the events of the Mirrodin Cycle taking place millennia after Karn disappeared from the plane. However, the events of Planar Chaos make it obvious that Mirrodin took place before the Time Spiral Cycle when Karn states that the plane hasn't seen conflict in a century. This was partly explained through the damage done to the fabric of the Multiverse by Dominaria's time rifts . The damage allowed Memnarch's delusions to become quasi-real and allowed for thousands of years of history to play out on the plane, while on the outside, only a few hundred years have passed.

The D&D Guildmasters' Guide to Ravnica establishes the Ravnican year of the Return to Ravnica block as 10,075 ZC, placing the events of the original Ravnica block 61-76 years in the past. The guide also confirms that Ravnican years are 365 days long. If 10,075 ZC is roughly equivalent to 4558, the length of Ravnican years must be roughly commensurate with Dominarian years for the original Ravnica Cycle to occur before the Mending.
In The Gathering Storm , multiple weeks are mentioned as passing between Vraska's arrival on Ravnica and the War of the Spark.

In Note for a Stranger , which itself takes place over at least five days, Huatli mentions she has been on Ravnica for "two months", which came after spending a "few days" on Kaladesh. We know all this must happen after Huatli meets Saheeli in Rivals of Ixalan , but before they have already been reunited in War of the Spark . Comparing this to how much time is said to pass between Jace planeswalking from Ixalan to Dominaria (which happened before Huatli left Ixalan), and when Belzenlok is defeated (which is established to be the day before the War of the Spark), we can tell that Huatli probably arrived on Ravnica soon after leaving Kaladesh, and started dating Saheeli shortly before the War of the Spark.

In Homesick, Nissa states, "But her friend—her best friend, her constant companion for two score years—couldn't answer." Nissa's Origin: Home is where she first awakens her animist powers, which would be two scores (or 40 years) previous to Homesick. The Great Aurora occurs during Nissa's Origin, placing Lorwyn as occurring 40 years before Kaladesh.

The events of the Zendikar storyline can only vaguely be established, thanks to Chandra's theft of the scroll in The Purifying Fire and Jace's experiences working as an agent of the Consortium to retrieve the scroll that Chandra stole. Roughly 3 years passed since Chandra acquired the scroll the first time, and Sarkhan Vol's presence tracking Chandra (apparently there for less than a year) indicates that the Zendikar story takes place after Alara as well.

While Chandra recalls there have been between one and three years passing since her last visit to Zendikar when she returns in Battle for Zendikar , based on Elspeth's age when her spark ignites and she first visits Theros, Daxos's ages on both of Elspeth's visits to Theros, Elspeth and Chandra's ages given in Magic 2014/Duels of the Planeswalkers and what Ajani did between the events of Theros and Kaladesh , one can calculate that close to three years probably passed. This is also consistent with Charandra's age during the events of Magic 2014/Duels of the Planeswalkers and Kaladesh .
The timeline of Tarkir was altered when Sarkhan Vol traveled back in time and saved Ugin from Bolas .

Some of the pieces of side-content from the original Innistrad storyline are dated and take place between Ava. 699 and 719, with the only major crossover to the main story being the war between Geralf and Gisa Cecani , which begins after the burning of the Cecani manor in late Ava. 715 and is ongoing at the end of the story in Ava. 719. If the original Innistrad set takes place in Ava. c. 719 and corresponds with 4558 AR, it would place Ava. 1 in c. 3840 AR. According to the Shadows Over Innistrad story " A Gaze Blank and Pitiless ," Avacyn is said to have first appeared and killed Liesa and her flight "a thousand years" before 4559, and according to the story Promises Old and New , Sorin is stated to have not attended a vampire banquet in "over a thousand years." This would imply that Ava, 1 occurred centuries after Avacyn's creation, potentially coinciding with the church's founding. It took Sorin "six millennia" to come up with his plan to create Avacyn. This places Edgar's ritual within a thousand years of -2441 AR, with his birth not long before.

Sorin sealed the Eldrazi on Zendikar "more than 6,000 years" before Battle for Zendikar block and by then was already "at least a thousand years old." Assuming the sealing would have been less than 7,000 years earlier, this places it between about -2441 and -1442 AR, and Sorin's birth in or before -2442.
Children of the Nameless takes place approximately one year after the events of Shadows over Innistrad .

Yahenni states that they have 54 days left to live in "Born of Aether", which takes place the evening of the day Chandra, Liliana, and Nissa arrive on Kaladesh. Yahenni has 12 minutes left in "In the Dead of Night" before gaining an additional 22 days through vampirism. Yahenni's penultimate party and passing away occur at the very end of the story, making Kaladesh Block roughly 76 days from beginning to end.

Yahenni's party happened one month after the Gatewatch arrived on Kaladesh. Tezzeret was defeated within two months of the Gatewatch's arrival. The hour of devastation happens "a few weeks" after the defeat of Tezzeret.

Azor arrived on Ixalan in preparation for Ugin 's and Nicol Bolas 's fight on Tarkir in 3279 AR. At some point after, he delivered the Immortal Sun to the city-state of Alta Torrezon . The Sun stayed at a monastery there for "generations" before being moved to the continent of Ixalan, where it ushered in the creation of Orazca and later the Sun Empire . Orazca served as the Sun Empire's capital for "many centuries" before it was moved again to the River Heralds . Orazca was lost to the Sun Empire for "centuries."

Torrezon split into three kingdoms in 803 BD, beginning the Apostasine War. The War raged for 250 years, experienced 50 years of peace, and began anew in 495 BD, "centuries" after the Immortal Sun was taken from Alta Torrezon. The Legion of Dusk marched out of Alta Torrezon and across the continent "a little over four centuries" before 5 Dawn Era. In the century before the Dawn Era, the Legion completed its conquest and refugees fled the continent, later forming the Brazen Coalition . As the Legion of Dusk reached Ixalan "5 years" before The Lost Caverns of Ixalan , in 5 Dawn Era, there is likely a year zero in the Legion's calendar, with 0 Dawn Era being 4558 AR.

In Ixalan , Tishana feels Jace 's attempt to planeswalk twice, on the day of the race to Orazca and two months prior. Jace attempts to planeswalk three times. Immediately after arriving on Ixalan, forty days later, on the day he is found by Vraska, and "several weeks" later, on the day of the race to Orazca. Thus, two months must have passed between Jace's being found and the race. Before leaving Ixalan, Jace noted that Gideon had "been trying to foist a workout regimen on [him] for a year now," so the entire Gatewatch era to that point may have lasted a couple more months than estimated.

The Age of the Sun "lasted for millennia." The Night War lasted 320 years. "Many centuries" after the first exodus, when humans traveled from the Core to the caverns, the Mycotyrant was born. This event also occurred "millennia" before 5 Dawn Era and caused humans to travel from the caverns to the plane's surface, later becoming the Sun Empire.
The Lost Caverns of Ixalan takes place "a year and some months" — but not "a year and a half" — after the New Phyrexian Invasion in 4562 AR.
The 4561 AR approximation for the events of Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest assumes that Will Kenrith and Rowan Kenrith sparked after the War of the Spark .
